title.en: Volume 303 Biographies 90: Fu Min, Chen Shiguan, Shi Yizhi, A Ke Dun, Sun Jiagan, Liang Shizheng
title.raw: 卷303 列傳九十 福敏 陈世倌 史贻直 阿克敦 孙嘉淦 梁诗正

sentences.zh: 列傳九十

translations.literal: Biographies 90.
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 90

sentences.zh: 福敏陳世倌史貽直阿克敦孫嘉淦梁詩正

translations.literal: Fu Min, Chen Shiguan, Shi Yizhi, Akedun, Sun Jiagan, Liang Shizheng.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Min, Chen Shiguan, Shi Yizhi, Akedun, Sun Jiagan, and Liang Shizheng

sentences.zh: 福敏，字龍翰，富察氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Min, styled Longhan, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Min (courtesy name Longhan), a Fuca clansman of the Manchu Bordered White Banner

sentences.zh: 康熙三十六年進士，選庶吉士，散館，以知縣待銓。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and after leaving the academy awaited assignment as a county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi degree in Kangxi year 36, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and after completing his academy term waited to be appointed a county magistrate

sentences.zh: 時世宗在籓邸，高宗初就傅，命福敏侍讀。

translations.literal: At that time the Prince of Yong was at his princely residence and the Heir Apparent had just begun his tutoring; Fu Min was ordered to serve as reader-in-attendance.
translations.idiomatic: While the future Yongzheng Emperor was still at his princely mansion and the future Qianlong Emperor had only begun his lessons, Fu Min was appointed to read with the young prince

sentences.zh: 及世宗即位，擢內閣學士，兼禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Yong acceded, Fu Min was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician and concurrently Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongzheng took the throne, Fu Min was made a Grand Secretariat academician and concurrent Vice Minister of Rites

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，遷吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng he was transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 3 he became Vice Minister of Personnel

sentences.zh: 出署浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as acting Governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out to act as Governor of Zhejiang

sentences.zh: 四年，擢左都御史，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to Censor-in-Chief of the Left and concurrently Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he was made Left Censor-in-Chief and concurrent Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy

sentences.zh: 復出署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: He again went out to serve as acting Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He again went out to serve as acting Governor-General of Huguang

sentences.zh: 沔陽、潛江等十州縣水災，疏請發常平倉穀治賑。

translations.literal: When ten prefectures and counties including Mianyang and Qianjiang suffered flood damage, he memorialized requesting grain from the ever-normal granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Floods struck ten prefectures and counties including Mianyang and Qianjiang; he memorialized to open the ever-normal granaries for relief

sentences.zh: 謬衝花苗叛，​​福敏檄貴州兵截後路，以湖廣兵搗其巢，討平之。

translations.literal: The Miaochong Hua Miao rebelled; Fu Min ordered Guizhou troops to cut off their retreat and Huguang troops to strike their lair, and the rebellion was suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Miaochong Hua Miao rose in revolt, Fu Min directed Guizhou forces to block their rear while Huguang troops stormed their stronghold until the uprising was put down

sentences.zh: 安陸、荊州被水，疏請老弱婦女治賑如常，而以丁壯修堤，俾民得食而堤亦完。

translations.literal: When Anlu and Jingzhou were inundated, he memorialized that the old, weak, and women should receive relief as usual while able-bodied men repaired the dikes, so the people would be fed and the dikes completed.
translations.idiomatic: After floods hit Anlu and Jingzhou, he proposed that the elderly, infirm, and women receive relief as before while able-bodied men worked on the dikes—feeding the people and finishing the embankments at once

sentences.zh: 上眷福敏厚，嘗手詔諭曰：「朕令爾暫攝總督，苟得其人，即命往替。

translations.literal: The emperor favored Fu Min deeply and once wrote him in his own hand: "I have had you temporarily act as governor-general; once a suitable man is found, I shall order him to replace you.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held Fu Min in high regard and once wrote him by hand: "I have asked you to hold the governorship temporarily; as soon as I find the right man, I will send him to take your place.

sentences.zh: 近日廊廟中頗乏才，皇子左右亦待爾輔翼。

translations.literal: Lately talent in the court is rather scarce, and the princes at my side also await your guidance.
translations.idiomatic: The court lately lacks able men, and the princes at my side still need your guidance as well.

sentences.zh: 留爾湖廣非得已，宜體朕意勉為之。

translations.literal: Keeping you in Huguang is not what I wish, but you should grasp my intent and do your best.
translations.idiomatic: Keeping you in Huguang is not my preference—yet I ask you to understand my intent and do your utmost.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed."

sentences.zh: 五年，召還京，授吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was recalled to the capital and appointed Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he was recalled to the capital and made Minister of Personnel

sentences.zh: 六年，以巡撫浙江時徇布政使佟吉圖動庫銀，奪職。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because while Governor of Zhejiang he had indulged the Provincial Treasurer Tong Jitu in drawing on treasury silver, he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he lost his post for having, as Zhejiang governor, allowed Provincial Treasurer Tong Jitu to misuse treasury funds

sentences.zh: 八年，命協理兵部侍郎，遷左都御史。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered to assist in the duties of Vice Minister of War and was transferred to Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he was assigned to assist as Vice Minister of War, then promoted to Left Censor-in-Chief

sentences.zh: 十年，署工部尚書，協辦大學士，旋署刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he acted as Minister of Works and assisting Grand Secretary, and soon after acted as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he served as acting Minister of Works and assisting Grand Secretary, then soon acted as Minister of Punishments

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年，擢武英殿大學士，兼工部尚書、翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianlong he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Hall of Military Glory, concurrently Minister of Works and Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 3 he became Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall, retaining the ministries of Works and the Hanlin chancellorship

sentences.zh: 四年，加太保，六年七月，高宗初幸木蘭行圍，福敏疏言：「行圍邊外，內外章奏按期馳送，較宮廷清穆勞逸迥殊。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was given the rank of Grand Tutor; in the seventh month of the sixth year, when the Qianlong Emperor first went to Mulan for the hunting encampment, Fu Min memorialized: "On the hunt beyond the passes, memorials from within and without are rushed back and forth on schedule—a labor and ease quite unlike the tranquil court.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he received the rank of Grand Tutor. In the seventh month of year 6, when Qianlong made his first autumn hunt at Mulan, Fu Min wrote: "On the hunting grounds beyond the passes, reports from inside and outside arrive on tight schedules—a strain quite unlike the quiet of court.

sentences.zh: 宜朝乾夕惕，清明在躬，從容應之。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should be vigilant morning and evening, keep clarity in person, and respond with composure.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should remain vigilant day and night, keep your mind clear, and answer affairs with calm deliberation.

sentences.zh: 留京百官，必因事警察，勿使偷惰者得行其私。

translations.literal: The officials left in the capital must be policed in their duties, lest the idle and negligent pursue private ends.
translations.idiomatic: Officials left in the capital must be kept to their duties, so the lazy cannot pursue private schemes.

sentences.zh: 巡行之日，言路宜舉大利害，不當瑣細瀆陳傷政體。

translations.literal: While Your Majesty is on tour, remonstrators should raise matters of great benefit and harm, not petty details that would injure the dignity of government.
translations.idiomatic: During the tour, censors should speak on great public interests, not petty matters that would cheapen the dignity of rule.

sentences.zh: 聖祖於獵地平易險阻無不了然，故周旋中度，馳射如神。

translations.literal: The Sage Ancestor knew every level place and hazard of the hunting grounds, and therefore moved with perfect measure and shot and rode like a spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Kangxi knew every rise and hollow of the hunt grounds, and so moved with perfect judgment and shot and rode as if inspired

sentences.zh: 原皇上籌度於先。

translations.literal: I pray that Your Majesty will plan ahead.
translations.idiomatic: I pray Your Majesty will plan ahead as he did.

sentences.zh: 弁兵布圍，未必無參差，乞少加從容，俾黽勉從事。

translations.literal: When soldiers and officers lay out the beat, there may be unevenness; I beg a little more leeway so they may strive in their tasks.
translations.idiomatic: When troops and officers set the beat, gaps may appear; I beg a little patience so they can do their best.

sentences.zh: 弁兵從行日久，資斧不繼，量加恩澤，費無多而惠無窮。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers on the long march may run short of funds; grant them measured favor—the cost is small and the benefit endless.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and men on the long march may run short of pay; a measured grant would cost little and do endless good.

sentences.zh: 」上諭曰：「覽大學士所奏，老成忠懇，補袞陳善，朕皆嘉納焉。

translations.literal: " The emperor instructed: "Having read the Grand Secretary's memorial, I find it seasoned, loyal, and sincere—repairing the robe and presenting good counsel—and I accept it all with approval.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor replied: "I have read the Grand Secretary's memorial—seasoned, loyal, and sincere, mending the state with good counsel—and I accept it all with approval.

sentences.zh: 」八年，疏陳時政，言：「河防事重，請如災民請賑例，便宜處置，以時上聞。

translations.literal: " In the eighth year he memorialized on current affairs, saying: "River defense is weighty; I ask that, as with disaster victims requesting relief, officials be allowed to act as circumstances require and report in good time.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 8 he memorialized on current policy: "River defense is vital; let officials act promptly as with famine relief, and report to the throne in due course.

sentences.zh: 災民流移，情非得已。

translations.literal: Disaster victims who drift away do so from necessity, not choice.
translations.idiomatic: People who flee disaster do so from necessity, not choice.

sentences.zh: 若有司不善拊循，徒禁越境，致輾轉溝壑，宜加以玩視罪。

translations.literal: If local officials do not comfort them well but only forbid crossing borders, causing them to perish in ditches and gullies, those officials should be charged with contempt for their duty.
translations.idiomatic: If officials fail to comfort them and only bar them from crossing borders, leaving them to die in ditches, they should be punished for neglect

sentences.zh: 江南、湖廣偏災，請留南漕賑濟。

translations.literal: Where Jiangnan and Huguang suffer partial disaster, I ask that southern tribute grain be retained for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Where Jiangnan and Huguang suffer partial famine, I ask that southern tribute grain be held back for relief

sentences.zh: 定數多寡，當出上裁。

translations.literal: How much to set aside should be decided by the throne.
translations.idiomatic: How much to retain should be decided by Your Majesty

sentences.zh: 庶上不虧儲，下足濟食。

translations.literal: Thus the state stores would not be depleted above, and the people below would have enough to eat.
translations.idiomatic: So the treasury would not be drained and the people would have enough to eat

sentences.zh: 」疏入，從之。

translations.literal: " When the memorial arrived, it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 十年，以疾乞解任，溫詔如所請，加太傅。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, citing illness he asked to be relieved; a gracious edict granted his request and he was given the rank of Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he asked to retire on grounds of illness; the emperor graciously agreed and made him Grand Preceptor

sentences.zh: 二十二年，卒，年八十四。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he died, aged eighty-four.
translations.idiomatic: He died in year 22, at the age of eighty-four

sentences.zh: 福敏嘗有疾，上臨視，及聞其卒，复親奠。

translations.literal: When Fu Min had been ill the emperor visited him in person, and on hearing of his death again offered sacrifice in person.
translations.idiomatic: When Fu Min had been ill the emperor visited him; on hearing of his death he again offered sacrifice in person

sentences.zh: 賜祭葬，祀賢良祠，諡文端。

translations.literal: Imperial sacrifices and funeral honors were granted; he was enshrined in the Temple of Worthies and given the posthumous title Wenduan.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted funeral rites, enshrined him in the Temple of Worthies, and gave him the posthumous name Wenduan

sentences.zh: 福敏性剛正，廓然無城府。

translations.literal: Fu Min's nature was upright and firm, open and without hidden designs.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Min was upright and forthright, without guile or hidden designs

sentences.zh: 直內廷與蔡世遠、雷鋐善，尤服膺硃軾。

translations.literal: Serving in the inner court he was close to Cai Shiyuan and Lei Hong, and especially revered Zhu Shi.
translations.idiomatic: In the inner court he was close to Cai Shiyuan and Lei Hong and especially revered Zhu Shi

sentences.zh: 既乞休，語鋐曰：「此位豈易稱？

translations.literal: After he had asked to retire, he said to Lei Hong: "Is this post easy to fill?
translations.idiomatic: After he retired he said to Lei Hong: "Is this post easy to fill?

sentences.zh: 我浮沉其間，君不我嗤耶？

translations.literal: I drifted through it—will you not laugh at me?
translations.idiomatic: I drifted through it for years—will you not laugh at me?

sentences.zh: 」四十四年，上製懷舊詩，於舊學諸臣皆稱先生，字而不名，言於軾得學之體，於世遠得學之用，於福敏得學之基。

translations.literal: " In the forty-fourth year the emperor composed a poem recalling old companions; of the teachers of his youth he called each "Master," using the courtesy name and not the personal name, saying that from Zhu Shi he gained the substance of learning, from Cai Shiyuan its application, and from Fu Min its foundation.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 44 the emperor wrote a poem of remembrance; of his early teachers he spoke as "Master," using courtesy names alone, and said that from Zhu Shi he learned the substance of learning, from Cai Shiyuan its use, and from Fu Min its foundation

sentences.zh: 六十年二月上丁，釋奠禮成，贈福敏太師，詔言：「衝齡就傅時，啟迪之力多也。

translations.literal: On the first ding day of the second month of the sixtieth year, when the Confucian sacrifice was completed, Fu Min was posthumously made Grand Preceptor; the edict said: "In his tender years when he first had tutors, the force of their instruction was great.
translations.idiomatic: On the first ding day of the second month of year 60, after the Confucian sacrifice, Fu Min was posthumously made Grand Preceptor; the edict said: "In his tender years when he first had tutors, their guidance meant much.

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed."

sentences.zh: 陳世倌，字秉之，浙江海寧人。

translations.literal: Chen Shiguan, styled Bingzhi, was a native of Haining in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shiguan (courtesy name Bingzhi) was from Haining, Zhejiang

sentences.zh: 父詵，自有傳。

translations.literal: His father Chen Shen has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chen Shen has a separate biography

sentences.zh: 世倌，康熙四十二年進士，改庶吉士。

translations.literal: Shiguan passed the jinshi in the forty-second year of Kangxi and was made a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: Shiguan took his jinshi in Kangxi year 42 and entered the Hanlin as a bachelor

sentences.zh: 自編修累遷侍讀學士，督順天學政。

translations.literal: From Compiler he rose in stages to Reader of the Hanlin and supervised education in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from compiler to Hanlin reader and served as education commissioner of Shuntian

sentences.zh: 父憂歸，起督江西學政，疏乞終制，得請。

translations.literal: He returned on his father's death, was recalled to supervise education in Jiangxi, memorialized asking to complete mourning, and was granted leave.
translations.idiomatic: He went home for his father's mourning, was recalled to supervise Jiangxi education, asked to finish mourning properly, and was allowed to do so

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，服闋，擢內閣學士，出為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, when mourning ended, he was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician and sent out as Governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 2, when mourning ended, he became a Grand Secretariat academician and was sent out as Governor of Shandong

sentences.zh: 時山東境旱蝗，糧運淺阻，世倌單車週曆，密察災輕重、吏能否，乃視事。

translations.literal: At that time Shandong suffered drought and locusts and grain transport was blocked in the shallows; Shiguan traveled alone through the circuit, secretly observing the severity of disaster and officials' competence, and only then took up his post.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong then suffered drought and locusts and grain transport was blocked in the shallows; Shiguan toured alone, quietly gauging disaster and officials' ability, and only then took up his duties

sentences.zh: 趣捕蝗略盡，並疏治運道，世宗書扇以賜。

translations.literal: He urged locust-catching until they were nearly gone and memorialized on repairing the transport channel; the Yongzheng Emperor wrote on a fan and bestowed it.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed locust eradication until the plague was nearly gone and memorialized on clearing the transport channel; Yongzheng wrote on a fan and gave it to him

sentences.zh: 世倌疏言：「社倉通有無、濟豐歉，古今可行。

translations.literal: Shiguan memorialized: "Communal granaries move surplus to shortage and ease plenty and famine—feasible in every age.
translations.idiomatic: Shiguan wrote: "Communal granaries move grain between surplus and shortage and ease feast and famine—they have worked in every age.

sentences.zh: 宜令各鄉勸富民輸穀，不限多寡，量予獎勸。

translations.literal: Each township should be urged to have wealthy households contribute grain, without limit on amount, with rewards in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: Each township should encourage wealthy households to contribute grain in any amount, with proportional rewards

sentences.zh: 舉公正鄉約三人司其出入，官為稽覈。

translations.literal: Three upright village elders should be chosen to manage receipts and disbursements, with officials auditing.
translations.idiomatic: Three upright village elders should manage receipts and disbursements under official audit

sentences.zh: 貧民春貸秋償，石納息二斗，歉則減之，十年後納息一斗。

translations.literal: The poor would borrow in spring and repay in autumn, two dou interest per shi of grain; in lean years interest would be reduced, and after ten years one dou per shi.
translations.idiomatic: The poor would borrow in spring and repay in autumn at two dou interest per shi; in bad years interest would be cut, and after ten years only one dou per shi

sentences.zh: 請飭諸行省先就數州縣行之。

translations.literal: I ask that all provinces first try this in a few prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that provinces first trial this in a few prefectures and counties

sentences.zh: 俟有成效，然後推廣。

translations.literal: After results appear, it may then be extended.
translations.idiomatic: Once it proves effective, it can be extended more widely

sentences.zh: 」下所司議行。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the relevant offices for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was sent to the relevant offices for implementation

sentences.zh: 又疏請禁回教，上以回教其來已久，限於種人，非蔓延難量。

translations.literal: He also memorialized asking to ban Islam; the emperor said Islam had long existed, was confined to its people, and was not an unmeasurable spreading threat.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to ban Islam; the emperor replied that Islam was long established, confined to its own communities, and not an uncontrollable spread

sentences.zh: 無故欲禁革，徒紛擾，非治理，罷其議。

translations.literal: To ban it without cause would only stir disorder and was not good governance; his proposal was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: A ban without cause would only stir disorder and was not good governance; the proposal was dismissed

sentences.zh: 又疏上沿海防衛五事，報可。

translations.literal: He also memorialized five points on coastal defense; approval was returned.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted five points on coastal defense, which were approved

sentences.zh: 四年，母憂歸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he returned on his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he went home for his mother's mourning

sentences.zh: 命治江南水利，坐遲悮奪職，並命赴曲阜督修孔子廟。

translations.literal: He was ordered to manage Jiangnan waterworks, was stripped of office for delay, and was also ordered to go to Qufu to supervise repair of the Confucius temple.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to manage Jiangnan waterworks, lost his post for delay, and was sent to Qufu to supervise repairs to the Confucius temple

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，起左副都御史。

translations.literal: When Qianlong acceded he was recalled as Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: When Qianlong took the throne he was recalled as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief

sentences.zh: 乾隆二年，授倉場侍郎，再遷工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong he was made Vice Minister of the Granary Circuit and soon after Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 2 he became Vice Minister of the Granary Circuit, then Minister of Works

sentences.zh: 六年，授文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he became Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Hall

sentences.zh: 是年秋，淮、徐、鳳、泗等處被水，上命侍郎週學健會總督高斌庀工役。

translations.literal: That autumn Huai, Xu, Feng, and Si were flooded; the emperor ordered Vice Minister Zhou Xuejian to join Governor-General Gao Bin in arranging works.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn floods struck Huai, Xu, Feng, and Si; the emperor ordered Vice Minister Zhou Xuejian to join Governor-General Gao Bin in organizing relief works

sentences.zh: 世倌屢疏陳行水卹災諸事，上即命乘傳往會學健等察勘。

translations.literal: Shiguan repeatedly memorialized on water control and disaster relief; the emperor at once ordered him to travel post-haste to join Xuejian and others in inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Shiguan repeatedly wrote on water control and disaster relief; the emperor at once sent him post-haste to join Xuejian and others on inspection

sentences.zh: 世倌言水勢高下必當親勘，請以通測量術者偕往，從之。

translations.literal: Shiguan said the rise and fall of the waters must be surveyed in person and asked that men skilled in surveying go with him; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Shiguan said water levels had to be surveyed in person and asked for skilled surveyors to accompany him; the request was granted

sentences.zh: 十二月，偕學健等疏陳籌畫工役，請待來歲二三月水涸施工。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, together with Xuejian and others, he memorialized on planning the works and asked to wait until the second or third month of the coming year when the water receded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he and Xuejian memorialized on the planned works and asked to wait until the second or third month of the coming year when the water fell

sentences.zh: 上曰：「世倌臨行奏言歲內可疏，積水盡消，今疏言仍待來歲二三月，其所籌畫皆不過就高斌、週學健所定規模而潤色之，別無奇謀碩畫，何必多此往返乎？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Before leaving Shiguan memorialized that within the year the channels could be dredged and the standing water cleared; now he memorializes to wait until the second or third month of next year. His plans are nothing but polishing what Gao Bin and Zhou Xuejian already fixed—no bold scheme at all. Why this needless journey back and forth?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Before he left, Shiguan said the channels could be cleared within the year and the floodwater drained; now he says to wait until next spring. His plans only polish what Gao Bin and Zhou Xuejian already set—no bold design at all. Why this needless round trip?

translations.literal: " (closing quotation mark in the source.)
translations.idiomatic: The edict closed."

sentences.zh: 九年，予假回籍，請致仕，不許。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was granted leave to return home and asked to retire; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he was granted leave to go home and asked to retire; the request was denied

sentences.zh: 疏言：「道經山東，聞有劇盜就逮。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Passing through Shandong I heard that a notorious bandit had been arrested.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "Passing through Shandong I heard a notorious bandit had been arrested.

sentences.zh: 因案關數省，遷延待質。

translations.literal: Because the case involved several provinces, proceedings dragged on awaiting evidence.
translations.idiomatic: Because the case crossed several provinces, proceedings dragged on awaiting evidence

sentences.zh: 劇盜既鞫得實，宜速誅。

translations.literal: Since the bandit's guilt is established upon examination, he should be executed at once.
translations.idiomatic: Since his guilt is established, he should be executed at once

sentences.zh: 請飭山東巡撫定讞，毋使久稽顯戮。

translations.literal: I ask that the Governor of Shandong be ordered to fix the sentence and not let public execution be long delayed.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the Shandong governor fix the sentence and not delay execution

sentences.zh: 」上韙其言。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved

sentences.zh: 假滿還職，加太子太保。

translations.literal: When leave ended he returned to office and was given the rank of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When his leave ended he returned to office and was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent

sentences.zh: 雲南巡撫劾屬吏，例當令總督覆讞。

translations.literal: The Governor of Yunnan impeached a subordinate official; by rule the Governor-General should review the case.
translations.idiomatic: The Yunnan governor impeached a subordinate; by rule the governor-general should review the case

sentences.zh: 世倌擬旨誤，下吏議奪職，上斥世倌卑瑣不稱大學士，宜如議奪職。

translations.literal: Shiguan drafted the rescript in error; the judicial offices recommended stripping him of office; the emperor rebuked him as petty and unworthy of a Grand Secretary and said the recommendation should stand.
translations.idiomatic: Shiguan drafted the rescript incorrectly; the judicial offices recommended stripping him of office; the emperor called him petty and unfit for a grand secretary and ordered the recommendation carried out

sentences.zh: 又別敕略謂：「朕斥世倌卑瑣，即如世倌與孔氏有連，乃於兗州私營田宅，冀分其餘潤。

translations.literal: In a separate edict he said in brief: "When I called Shiguan petty, I meant also that though connected to the Kong clan, he privately acquired fields and houses at Yanzhou hoping to share their surplus profit.
translations.idiomatic: In a separate edict he said: "When I called Shiguan petty, I meant also that though tied to the Kong clan, he privately bought fields and houses at Yanzhou hoping to share their profits.

sentences.zh: 此豈大臣所為？

translations.literal: Is this what a great minister should do?
translations.idiomatic: Is this what a great minister should do?

sentences.zh: 今既奪職，下山東巡撫毋令居兗州。

translations.literal: Now that he has been stripped of office, tell the Governor of Shandong not to let him reside at Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Now that he has lost his post, tell the Shandong governor not to let him live at Yanzhou

sentences.zh: 」十五年，入京祝嘏，賞原銜。

translations.literal: " In the fifteenth year he came to the capital to offer birthday congratulations and was granted his former rank.
translations.idiomatic: " In year 15 he came to the capital for the birthday celebration and had his former rank restored

sentences.zh: 十六年，命入閣辦事，兼管禮部事。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was ordered into the Grand Council to handle affairs and concurrently to manage the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16 he was ordered into the Grand Council and to manage the Ministry of Rites concurrently

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以老病乞休，詔從其請，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, citing age and illness he asked to retire; an edict granted his request and he was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 he asked to retire on grounds of age and illness; the emperor agreed and made him Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent

sentences.zh: 二十三年春，陛辭，御製詩賜之，謂「皇祖朝臣無幾也」。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-third year, taking leave at court, he was given an imperial poem saying, "Few ministers of my grandfather's court remain.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 23, bidding farewell at court, he received an imperial poem saying, "Few ministers of my grandfather's court remain.

sentences.zh: 賚銀五千兩，在家食俸。

translations.literal: Five thousand taels of silver were bestowed and he was granted salary while at home.
translations.idiomatic: He received five thousand taels of silver and was granted salary while at home

sentences.zh: 未行，卒，諡文勤。

translations.literal: Before he could depart he died and was given the posthumous title Wenqin.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could leave he died and was given the posthumous name Wenqin

sentences.zh: 世倌治宋五子之學，廉儉純篤。

translations.literal: Shiguan studied the learning of the Five Masters of the Song, and was frugal, pure, and sincere.
translations.idiomatic: Shiguan studied the Neo-Confucian masters of the Song and was frugal, upright, and sincere

sentences.zh: 入對及民間水旱疾苦，必反覆具陳，或繼以泣。

translations.literal: In audience and on the people's sufferings from flood and drought he would set forth the facts again and again, sometimes weeping as he spoke.
translations.idiomatic: In audience, and on the people's flood and drought hardships, he would lay out the facts again and again, sometimes weeping as he spoke

sentences.zh: 上輒霽顏聽之，曰：「陳世倌又來為百姓哭矣！

translations.literal: The emperor would always listen with a cleared countenance and say, "Chen Shiguan has come to weep for the people again!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would always listen with a softened face and say, "Chen Shiguan has come to weep for the people again!

sentences.zh: 」雖中被譴訶，終亮其端謹。

translations.literal: " Though he sometimes received rebuke and censure, in the end the emperor recognized his upright caution.
translations.idiomatic: " Though he was sometimes rebuked, in the end the emperor recognized his upright caution

sentences.zh: 其後南巡，猶遣官祭其墓雲。

translations.literal: Afterwards, on southern tours, officials were still sent to offer sacrifice at his tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On later southern tours the court still sent officials to sacrifice at his tomb

sentences.zh: 史貽直，字儆弦，江蘇溧陽人。

translations.literal: Shi Yizhi, styled Jingxian, was a native of Liyang in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Yizhi (courtesy name Jingxian) was from Liyang, Jiangsu

sentences.zh: 父夔，康熙二十一年進士，官至詹事。

translations.literal: His father Shi Kui passed the jinshi in the twenty-first year of Kangxi and rose to Chamberlain of the Household.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shi Kui took his jinshi in Kangxi year 21 and rose to Chamberlain of the Household

sentences.zh: 貽直少嫺掌故。

translations.literal: From youth Yizhi was well versed in institutional precedents.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Yizhi was well versed in court precedent

sentences.zh: 三十九年，成進士，年十九。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he passed the jinshi examination, aged nineteen.
translations.idiomatic: In year 39 he passed the jinshi examination at the age of nineteen

sentences.zh: 自檢討五遷侍讀學士。

translations.literal: From Compiler he was promoted five times to Reader of the Hanlin.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from compiler through five promotions to Hanlin reader

sentences.zh: 雍正初，命在南書房行走，再遷吏部侍郎，歷工部、戶部。

translations.literal: Early in Yongzheng he was ordered to serve in the Southern Study, then promoted to Vice Minister of Personnel and served in the Ministries of Works and Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yongzheng he served in the Southern Study, then became Vice Minister of Personnel and held posts in Works and Revenue

sentences.zh: 命如河南按總督田文鏡劾信陽知州黃振國等，定讞入告。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go to Henan to investigate Governor-General Tian Wenjing's impeachment of Xinyang Prefect Huang Zhenguo and others, fix the sentences, and report to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent to Henan to investigate Governor-General Tian Wenjing's case against Xinyang Prefect Huang Zhenguo and others, fix the sentences, and report to the throne

sentences.zh: 上蔡知縣張球，文鏡所嘗薦，貽直等發其諱盜。

translations.literal: Shangcai Magistrate Zhang Qiu, whom Wenjing had once recommended, was found by Yizhi and others to have concealed theft.
translations.idiomatic: Shangcai Magistrate Zhang Qiu, whom Wenjing had once recommended, was exposed by Yizhi and others for concealing theft

sentences.zh: 下吏議，文鏡疏自劾。

translations.literal: The case went to the judicial offices; Wenjing memorialized impeaching himself.
translations.idiomatic: The case went to the judicial offices, and Wenjing memorialized to impeach himself

sentences.zh: 復命如山西按前總督年羹堯領河東鹽政，私其子撓鹽法。

translations.literal: He was again ordered to Shanxi to investigate former Governor-General Nian Gengyao's control of Hedong salt administration and his son's private interference with the salt laws.
translations.idiomatic: He was again sent to Shanxi to investigate former Governor-General Nian Gengyao's control of Hedong salt administration and his son's private interference with the salt laws

sentences.zh: 七年，復命如福建按巡撫硃綱劾按察使喬學尹等，並論如律。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was again ordered to Fujian to investigate Governor Zhu Gang's impeachment of Provincial Judge Qiao Xueyin and others; all were sentenced according to law.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he was sent again to Fujian to investigate Governor Zhu Gang's case against Provincial Judge Qiao Xueyin and others; all were sentenced according to law

sentences.zh: 上獎其公當，命署福建總督。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his fairness and ordered him to act as Governor-General of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his fairness and appointed him acting Governor-General of Fujian

sentences.zh: 福建水師巡海，挾巿易物蝕關稅，貽直為申禁。

translations.literal: The Fujian naval forces on coastal patrol traded goods at markets to erode customs revenue; Yizhi memorialized to forbid this.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian naval patrols traded at markets to skim customs revenue; Yizhi memorialized to forbid the practice

sentences.zh: 福州、興化、泉州、漳州四府以米少，倉穀不如例糶易，貽直請以台灣應輸兵米易穀運四府，以次糶舊存新；

translations.literal: The four prefectures of Fuzhou, Xinghua, Quanzhou, and Zhangzhou had little rice and could not sell granary grain as usual; Yizhi asked that Taiwan's military rice quota be exchanged for grain and shipped to the four prefectures, selling old stock before new in turn;
translations.idiomatic: The four prefectures of Fuzhou, Xinghua, Quanzhou, and Zhangzhou lacked rice and could not sell granary grain as usual; Yizhi asked to exchange Taiwan's military rice quota for grain shipped to the four prefectures and to sell old stock before new in turn;

sentences.zh: 內地兵戍台灣，往還擾番社，貽直請下台灣總兵，戍兵往還，遣裨將檢押：皆如所議行。

translations.literal: garrison troops from the interior going to and from Taiwan disturbed aboriginal communities; Yizhi asked the Taiwan commander removed from escort duty and that deputy generals inspect troops on the route—all were approved and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: interior garrisons going to and from Taiwan disturbed aboriginal communities; Yizhi asked the Taiwan commander relieved of escort duty and deputy generals assigned to inspect troops on the route—all were approved and carried out

sentences.zh: 八年，調署兩江總督，以本籍疏辭，勿許。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to act as Governor-General of Liangjiang; he memorialized to decline on grounds of native place and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he was transferred to act as Governor-General of Liangjiang; he asked to decline on grounds of native place and was refused

sentences.zh: 授左都御史，仍留兩江。

translations.literal: He was made Censor-in-Chief of the Left but remained in Liangjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Left Censor-in-Chief but remained in Liangjiang

sentences.zh: 九年，召還。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he was recalled to the capital

sentences.zh: 時師徵準噶爾，陝西、甘肅當師行道，任餽餉。

translations.literal: At that time the army was campaigning against the Dzungars; Shaanxi and Gansu lay on the army's route and bore responsibility for supplies.
translations.idiomatic: The army was then campaigning against the Dzungars; Shaanxi and Gansu lay on the route and had to supply the forces

sentences.zh: 命偕侍郎杭奕祿等宣諭化導，旋命協理陝西巡撫，擢兵部尚書，仍留陝西。

translations.literal: He was ordered with Vice Minister Hang Yilu and others to proclaim and guide the people, then to assist in governing Shaanxi as governor, was promoted to Minister of War, and remained in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered with Vice Minister Hang Yilu and others to proclaim imperial policy, then to assist the Shaanxi governor, was promoted to Minister of War, and remained in Shaanxi

sentences.zh: 十年，署巡撫。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he acted as governor

sentences.zh: 廷議禁燒鍋，下諸行省。

translations.literal: The court debated banning liquor stills and sent the decision to all provinces.
translations.idiomatic: The court debated banning liquor stills and sent the order to all provinces

sentences.zh: 貽直疏言：「年豐糧羨；

translations.literal: Yizhi memorialized: "In years of abundance grain is plentiful;
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi wrote: "In years of abundance grain is plentiful;

sentences.zh: 燒鍋亦民間謀生之一事。

translations.literal: distilling is also one way the people make a living.
translations.idiomatic: distilling is also one way the people make a living.

sentences.zh: 當視年事豐歉，審民力盈虛，加以董勸。

translations.literal: One should consider whether the year is plentiful or lean, weigh the people's strength or exhaustion, and supervise and guide accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Policy should follow whether the year is plentiful or lean, weigh the people's strength or exhaustion, and supervise accordingly

sentences.zh: 」上許為得因時制宜之意。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved this as grasping the idea of adapting measures to the times.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved this as adapting policy to the times

sentences.zh: 湖廣總督邁柱請疏湖廣荊子關至陝西龍駒寨水道，便轉餉。

translations.literal: Governor-General Mai Zhu of Huguang asked to dredge the waterway from Jingzi Pass in Huguang to Longju Stockade in Shaanxi to ease transport of supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Mai Zhu of Huguang asked to dredge the waterway from Jingzi Pass in Huguang to Longju Stockade in Shaanxi to ease supply transport

sentences.zh: 貽直疏言：「荊子關至龍駒寨，舊有丹河，行兩山間，紆折三百七十里。

translations.literal: Yizhi memorialized: "From Jingzi Pass to Longju Stockade there was formerly the Dan River, running between two mountains in a winding course of three hundred and seventy li.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi wrote: "From Jingzi Pass to Longju Stockade the old Dan River ran between mountains in a winding course of three hundred and seventy li.

sentences.zh: 夏秋間民引以溉田，築堰蓄流，涓滴必爭。

translations.literal: In summer and autumn the people divert it to irrigate fields, build weirs to store the flow, and fight over every drop.
translations.idiomatic: In summer and autumn farmers divert it to irrigate, build weirs to hold the flow, and fight over every drop

sentences.zh: 雨後山水驟至，纖路輒斷，實不宜於輓運。

translations.literal: After rain mountain torrents arrive suddenly and the narrow path is often cut; it is truly unsuited to transport.
translations.idiomatic: After rain mountain torrents cut the narrow path; it is truly unsuited to transport

sentences.zh: 臣察湖廣轉餉艱難，當於河南府陝州傍河諸州縣積穀，行轉搬之策。

translations.literal: Your servant finds Huguang supply transport difficult; grain should be stored in prefectures and counties along the river near Henan Fu and Shaanzhou, using a relay transport plan.
translations.idiomatic: I find Huguang supply transport difficult; grain should be stored in riverine prefectures and counties near Henan Fu and Shaanzhou and moved by relay

sentences.zh: 浚治丹河，宜若可緩。

translations.literal: Dredging the Dan River may properly be deferred.
translations.idiomatic: Dredging the Dan River may properly wait

sentences.zh: 」上韙貽直言，格邁柱議不行。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved Yizhi's words and blocked Mai Zhu's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved Yizhi's view and rejected Mai Zhu's proposal

sentences.zh: 旋授戶部尚書，總理陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Minister of Revenue and given overall charge of the Shaanxi governorship.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he became Minister of Revenue with overall charge of Shaanxi

sentences.zh: 十三年七月，召還。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirteenth year he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 13 he was recalled

sentences.zh: 八月，世宗崩，高宗即位，貽直入對，高宗出世宗遺念衣賜貽直，勗以始終一致。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Yongzheng died and Qianlong acceded; Yizhi had audience; Qianlong brought out Yongzheng's mourning garment and bestowed it on Yizhi, urging him to remain consistent to the end.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yongzheng died and Qianlong acceded; at audience Qianlong brought out Yongzheng's mourning garment and gave it to Yizhi, urging steadfast loyalty

sentences.zh: 貽直泣，上亦泣不止。

translations.literal: Yizhi wept, and the emperor wept without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi wept, and the emperor wept without cease

sentences.zh: 貽直疏言：「科道及吏、禮二部宜循舊制用科目；

translations.literal: Yizhi memorialized: "Censors and the Ministries of Personnel and Rites should follow the old system of jinshi appointments;
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi wrote: "Censors and the Ministries of Personnel and Rites should follow the old system of jinshi appointments;

sentences.zh: 官吏遷擢，捐棄階資，幸進者不以為公，沉滯者不勝其怨，宜亦循舊制存階級；

translations.literal: in promotion of officials, if rank and seniority are cast aside, those who advance by favor will not think it fair and those long stalled will be full of resentment—the old system of ranks should also be kept;
translations.idiomatic: if promotion casts aside rank and seniority, favorites will not think it fair and the long-stalled will resent it—the old rank system should be kept as well;

sentences.zh: 河南各州縣報墾砂礫山岡，按畝昇科，小民鬻兒女以應輸將，州縣官勸捐，有損國體。

translations.literal: Henan prefectures and counties report reclaiming gravel hills and raise tax by the mu; common people sell sons and daughters to meet payments, and magistrates urge donations—this injures the dignity of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Henan prefectures and counties report reclaiming gravel hills and raise tax by the mu; common people sell their children to pay, and magistrates urge donations—this injures the dignity of the state

sentences.zh: 請簡廉明公正大臣撫綏其地，則情弊立見。

translations.literal: I ask that upright and fair great ministers be chosen to pacify those regions, and abuses will at once appear.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that upright ministers be chosen to pacify those regions, and abuses will at once appear

sentences.zh: 」事下總理事務王大臣議行。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the Prince Regents in charge of affairs for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was referred to the Prince Regents for deliberation and implementation

sentences.zh: 尋命署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to act as Governor-General of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed acting Governor-General of Huguang

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，疏言：「舊制州縣虧倉穀，議罪：穀一石當銀一兩，時值實不及。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong he memorialized: "Under the old rule when prefectures and counties were short of granary grain, punishment was reckoned at one tael of silver per shi of grain, though the actual value fell short.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 1 he wrote: "Under the old rule when prefectures and counties were short of granary grain, punishment was reckoned at one tael of silver per shi of grain, though the actual value fell short

sentences.zh: 諸雜糧皆視穀，尤失平。

translations.literal: All miscellaneous grains were treated like grain—especially unfair.
translations.idiomatic: All miscellaneous grains were treated like grain—especially unfair

sentences.zh: 」部議米一石當銀一兩，穀及諸雜糧皆當銀五錢，著為令。

translations.literal: " The ministry ruled that rice should be one tael per shi and grain and miscellaneous grains five mace each, and this was made regulation.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministry ruled rice at one tael per shi and grain and miscellaneous grains at five mace each, and this was made regulation

sentences.zh: 武昌城西南當江、漢合流處，舊有長堤。

translations.literal: Southwest of Wuchang city where the Yangzi and Han meet, there was formerly a long dike.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest of Wuchang where the Yangzi and Han meet, there was formerly a long dike

sentences.zh: 貽直令所司履勘重築，自王惠橋至土城磯，堤千三百餘丈，期三歲而畢。

translations.literal: Yizhi ordered the offices to survey and rebuild it from Wanghui Bridge to Tucheng Jetty, more than thirteen hundred zhang of dike, to be completed in three years.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi ordered a survey and rebuild from Wanghui Bridge to Tucheng Jetty—more than thirteen hundred zhang of dike—to be finished in three years

sentences.zh: 湖廣為兩淮行鹽地，而地錯入川、粵，凡巴東、歸州、道州、寧遠等九州縣民私食川、粵鹽，兩淮鹽政尹會一以為言。

translations.literal: Huguang was Lianghuai salt territory, but its land interpenetrated Sichuan and Guangdong; in nine prefectures and counties including Badong, Guizhou, Daozhou, and Ningyuan the people privately consumed Sichuan and Guangdong salt; Lianghuai Salt Controller Yin Huiyi raised the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang was Lianghuai salt territory, but its land interpenetrated Sichuan and Guangdong; in nine prefectures and counties including Badong, Guizhou, Daozhou, and Ningyuan people privately consumed Sichuan and Guangdong salt; Lianghuai Salt Controller Yin Huiyi raised the matter

sentences.zh: 貽直言湖廣行兩淮鹽歲七十餘萬引，諸州縣僻遠，兩淮鹽不至，強而行之，官商且交困。

translations.literal: Yizhi said Huguang consumed more than seven hundred thousand lianghuai salt certificates yearly; the prefectures and counties were remote, lianghuai salt did not reach them, and forcing it would distress both officials and merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi said Huguang consumed more than seven hundred thousand lianghuai salt certificates yearly; remote prefectures and counties could not be reached by lianghuai salt, and forcing it would distress officials and merchants alike

sentences.zh: 部議如貽直奏。

translations.literal: The ministry ruled as Yizhi memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry ruled as Yizhi had proposed

sentences.zh: 湖南城步等縣苗酋蒲寅山、鳳老一等為亂，貽直與巡撫高其倬等討平之，上嘉其勞。

translations.literal: Miao chiefs Pu Yinshan, Feng Laoyi, and others rebelled in Chengbu and other counties of Hunan; Yizhi with Governor Gao Qizhuo and others suppressed them, and the emperor praised their labor.
translations.idiomatic: Miao chiefs Pu Yinshan, Feng Laoyi, and others rebelled in Chengbu and other Hunan counties; Yizhi with Governor Gao Qizhuo and others put them down, and the emperor praised their service

sentences.zh: 召還，歷工、刑、兵、吏諸部尚書。

translations.literal: Recalled, he served in turn as Minister of Works, Punishments, War, and Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he served in turn as Minister of Works, Punishments, War, and Personnel

sentences.zh: 七年，命署直隸總督。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to act as Governor-General of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he was appointed acting Governor-General of Zhili

sentences.zh: 復召還，協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Recalled again, he served as assisting Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled again, he served as assisting Grand Secretary

sentences.zh: 九年，授文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Literary Depth.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he became Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Hall

sentences.zh: 十一年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was given the rank of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent

sentences.zh: 貽直子奕昂，官山東運河道，以巡撫鄂昌薦，命署甘肅布政使。

translations.literal: Yizhi's son Yi Ang held the Shandong grain transport post; on recommendation of Governor E Chang he was ordered to act as Provincial Treasurer of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi's son Yi Ang held the Shandong grain transport post; on Governor E Chang's recommendation he was appointed acting Provincial Treasurer of Gansu

sentences.zh: 二十年，鄂昌坐事籍沒，得貽直請託狀，上念貽直勤慎，不深罪，令致仕回籍，召奕昂還京。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year E Chang was punished and his property confiscated; a petition from Yizhi on his behalf was found; the emperor, mindful of Yizhi's diligence, did not punish him deeply but ordered him to retire home and recalled Yi Ang to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 E Chang was punished and his property confiscated; a petition from Yizhi on his behalf was found; mindful of Yizhi's diligence, the emperor did not punish him deeply but ordered him to retire home and recalled Yi Ang to the capital

sentences.zh: 二十二年，上南巡，貽直迎駕沂州，令在家食俸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, on the emperor's southern tour, Yizhi welcomed the imperial carriage at Yizhou and was granted salary while at home.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22, on the southern tour, Yizhi welcomed the emperor at Yizhou and was granted salary while at home

sentences.zh: 尋召還，仍授大學士。

translations.literal: Soon recalled, he was again made Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Soon recalled, he was again made Grand Secretary

sentences.zh: 途中病作，遣御醫就視。

translations.literal: Illness struck on the road and an imperial physician was sent to attend him.
translations.idiomatic: He fell ill on the road and an imperial physician was sent to attend him

sentences.zh: 至京，命領工部，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: On reaching the capital he was ordered to head the Ministry of Works and was given the rank of Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching the capital he was ordered to head the Ministry of Works and was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent

sentences.zh: 二十五年，上以貽直成進士已六十年，賜詩獎為「人瑞」。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, as Yizhi had passed the jinshi sixty years before, the emperor bestowed a poem praising him as a "human treasure."
translations.idiomatic: In year 25, as Yizhi had passed the jinshi sixty years before, the emperor bestowed a poem praising him as a "human treasure"

sentences.zh: 尋命遇祀典不必隨班行禮，以肩輿入直。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered that at sacrifices he need not follow the ranks in ceremony and might enter duty in a sedan chair.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was excused from joining ceremonial ranks at sacrifices and allowed to attend duty in a sedan chair

sentences.zh: 二十七年，貽直乞致仕，命不必兼攝工部，歲加俸五百金。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year Yizhi asked to retire; he was told he need not concurrently hold the Ministry of Works and was given five hundred taels of salary yearly in addition.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 Yizhi asked to retire; he was told he need not hold the Ministry of Works concurrently and was given five hundred taels of salary yearly in addition

sentences.zh: 二十八年，卒，年八十二，贈太保，祀賢良祠，諡文靖。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he died, aged eighty-two; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor, enshrined in the Temple of Worthies, and given the posthumous title Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28 he died at eighty-two; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor, enshrined in the Temple of Worthies, and given the posthumous name Wenjing

sentences.zh: 貽直為政持大體，不苟為異同。

translations.literal: In government Yizhi held to the larger pattern and was not partisan for or against.
translations.idiomatic: In government Yizhi held to the larger pattern and did not take sides for faction

sentences.zh: 性強記，飭舉止，善為辭令。

translations.literal: His memory was strong, his deportment restrained, and he was skilled in formal speech.
translations.idiomatic: He had a strong memory, restrained deportment, and skill in formal speech

sentences.zh: 年羹堯既誅，世宗問貽直：「汝亦羹堯薦耶？

translations.literal: After Nian Gengyao was executed, Yongzheng asked Yizhi: "Were you also recommended by Gengyao?
translations.idiomatic: After Nian Gengyao was executed, Yongzheng asked Yizhi: "Were you also recommended by Gengyao?

sentences.zh: 」貽直免冠對曰：「薦臣者羹堯，用臣者皇上。

translations.literal: " Yizhi removed his hat and answered: "Gengyao recommended your servant; Your Majesty employs your servant.
translations.idiomatic: " Yizhi removed his hat and answered: "Gengyao recommended me; Your Majesty employs me.

sentences.zh: 」及事高宗，耄矣，嘗奏事，拜起舒遲。

translations.literal: " Serving Qianlong, he was aged; once when memorializing he rose and bowed slowly.
translations.idiomatic: " Serving Qianlong in old age, he once rose and bowed slowly when presenting a memorial

sentences.zh: 高宗問：「卿老憊乎？

translations.literal: Qianlong asked: "Are you weary with age?
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong asked: "Are you weary with age?

sentences.zh: 」貽直對曰：「皇上到臣年，當自知之。

translations.literal: " Yizhi answered: "When Your Majesty reaches my age, you will know for yourself.
translations.idiomatic: " Yizhi answered: "When Your Majesty reaches my age, you will know for yourself.

sentences.zh: 」高宗為霽顏。

translations.literal: " Qianlong's countenance cleared.
translations.idiomatic: " Qianlong's countenance cleared

sentences.zh: 子奕簪，乾隆十年進士，官左春坊左贊善；

translations.literal: His son Yi Zan passed the jinshi in the tenth year of Qianlong and held the post of Left Assistant in the Eastern Palace;
translations.idiomatic: His son Yi Zan passed the jinshi in Qianlong year 10 and held the post of Left Assistant in the Eastern Palace;

sentences.zh: 奕昂，以舉人授刑部員外郎，自署甘肅布政使召還京，旋授福建按察使，再遷兵部侍郎，以口語罷；

translations.literal: Yi Ang, as a provincial graduate, was made an Outer Director in the Ministry of Punishments; recalled from acting Gansu treasurer to the capital, he was soon made Provincial Judge of Fujian, then Vice Minister of War, and was dismissed for a verbal slip;
translations.idiomatic: Yi Ang, as a provincial graduate, was made an Outer Director in the Ministry of Punishments; recalled from acting Gansu treasurer, he soon became Provincial Judge of Fujian, then Vice Minister of War, and was dismissed for a verbal slip;

sentences.zh: 奕朅，官山西潞安知府，高宗命留京侍貽直，授四品京堂。

translations.literal: Yi Ti held the prefecture of Lu'an in Shanxi; Qianlong ordered him kept in the capital to attend Yizhi and gave him a fourth-rank capital post.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Ti was prefect of Lu'an in Shanxi; Qianlong ordered him kept in the capital to attend Yizhi and gave him a fourth-rank capital post

sentences.zh: 阿克敦，字仲和，章佳氏，滿洲正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Akedun, styled Zhonghe, of the Zhangjia clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Akedun (courtesy name Zhonghe), a Zhangjia clansman of the Manchu Plain Blue Banner

sentences.zh: 康熙四十八年進士，改庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Kangxi he passed the jinshi, became a Hanlin bachelor, and was made Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He took his jinshi in Kangxi year 48, entered the Hanlin as a bachelor, and was made compiler

sentences.zh: 五十二年，充河南鄉試考官。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year he served as examiner for the Henan provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In year 52 he served as examiner for the Henan provincial examination

sentences.zh: 五十三年，上以阿克敦學問優，典試有聲名，特擢侍講學士。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year the emperor, because Akedun's learning was excellent and his service as examiner had won renown, specially promoted him to Lecturer of the Hanlin.
translations.idiomatic: In year 53 the emperor, finding Akedun's learning excellent and his examining service renowned, specially promoted him to Hanlin lecturer

sentences.zh: 五十五年，轉侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year he was transferred to Reader of the Hanlin.
translations.idiomatic: In year 55 he was transferred to Hanlin reader

sentences.zh: 五十六年，朝鮮國王李焞病目，使求空青，命阿克敦齎賜之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year King Yi Sun of Korea suffered eye disease and sent to request azurite; Akedun was ordered to carry it as imperial gift.
translations.idiomatic: In year 56 King Yi Sun of Korea suffered eye disease and requested azurite; Akedun was ordered to carry it as an imperial gift

sentences.zh: 遷詹事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Chamberlain of the Household.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Chamberlain of the Household

sentences.zh: 五十七年，擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year he was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: In year 57 he was promoted to Grand Secretariat academician

sentences.zh: 六十一年，朝鮮國王李昀請立其弟昑為世弟，命阿克敦偕侍衛佛倫充使冊封。

translations.literal: In the sixty-first year King Yi Yun of Korea asked to establish his younger brother Bing as heir brother; Akedun with Guard Foulun were ordered as envoys to invest him.
translations.idiomatic: In year 61 King Yi Yun of Korea asked to establish his younger brother Bing as heir brother; Akedun with Guard Foulun were sent as envoys to invest him

sentences.zh: 擢兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Minister of War

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，兼翰林院掌院學士，充聖祖實錄副總裁。

translations.literal: When Yongzheng acceded he concurrently served as Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy and as vice director of the Veritable Records of the Sage Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongzheng acceded he concurrently served as Hanlin chancellor and vice director of Kangxi's Veritable Records

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，命專管翰林院掌院學士，充國史、會典副總裁。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng he was ordered to take sole charge of the Hanlin chancellorship and serve as vice director of the National History and the Collected Statutes.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 1 he was ordered to take sole charge of the Hanlin chancellorship and serve as vice director of the National History and Collected Statutes

sentences.zh: 复偕散秩大臣舒魯冊封朝鮮國王李昑。

translations.literal: Again with Minister without Portfolio Shulu he was sent to invest King Yi Bing of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Again with Minister without Portfolio Shulu he was sent to invest King Yi Bing of Korea

sentences.zh: 三年，授禮部侍郎，兼兵部。

translations.literal: In the third year he was made Vice Minister of Rites, concurrently of War.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he became Vice Minister of Rites, concurrently of War

sentences.zh: 四年，調兵部，兼國子監祭酒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to War, concurrently Rector of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he was transferred to War, concurrently Rector of the Imperial Academy

sentences.zh: 兩廣總督孔毓珣入覲，命阿克敦署總督，兼廣州將軍。

translations.literal: When Governor-General Kong Yuxun of Liangguang came to audience, Akedun was ordered to act as governor-general and concurrently General of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Governor-General Kong Yuxun of Liangguang came to audience, Akedun was ordered to act as governor-general and concurrently General of Guangzhou

sentences.zh: 奏劾碣石總兵陳良弼索漁船陋規、左翼總兵藍奉以二子冒補把總，倚勢累兵。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching Jieshi Commander Chen Liangbi for demanding petty fees from fishing boats and Left Wing Commander Lan Feng for having his two sons fraudulently appointed platoon commanders, abusing power to burden the troops.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized against Jieshi Commander Chen Liangbi for demanding petty fees from fishing boats and Left Wing Commander Lan Feng for having his two sons fraudulently appointed platoon commanders, abusing power to burden the troops

sentences.zh: 上嘉阿克敦實奏，命擇勝任之人，具本題參。

translations.literal: The emperor praised Akedun's factual memorial and ordered that capable men be chosen to submit formal impeachments.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Akedun's factual report and ordered capable men chosen to submit formal impeachments

sentences.zh: 高要、高明、四會、三水、南海等五縣民瀕江築圩，開竇建徬，引水溉田，謂之「圍基」。

translations.literal: In the five counties of Gaoyao, Gaoming, Sihui, Sanshui, and Nanhai the people along the river built embankments, opened sluices, and erected dikes to draw water for irrigation, calling them "polder bases."
translations.idiomatic: In the five counties of Gaoyao, Gaoming, Sihui, Sanshui, and Nanhai people along the river built embankments, opened sluices, and erected dikes to draw water for irrigation, calling them "polder bases"

sentences.zh: 江漲多潰決，巡撫楊文乾奏請以最衝改石工，次沖改椿埽，計費數十萬，借帑修築，且議以開捐補款，阿克敦意與相左。

translations.literal: When the river rose the dikes often burst; Governor Yang Wenqian memorialized asking that the most critical sections be changed to stone works and the next to pile and fascine works, costing several hundred thousand, borrowing from the treasury for repair and proposing sale of offices to make up funds—Akedun's view opposed his.
translations.idiomatic: When the river rose the dikes often burst; Governor Yang Wenqian asked that the most critical sections be changed to stone works and the next to pile and fascine works, costing several hundred thousand, with treasury loans for repair and sale of offices to make up funds—Akedun disagreed

sentences.zh: 五年，疏言：「高要等縣沿江圍基，俱系土工，歲十一月後，有司督率鄉民按畝分工，加卑培薄，民不為苦，官無所費。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he memorialized: "The riverside polder bases in Gaoyao and other counties are all earthen works; after the eleventh month each year the magistrates lead villagers in labor by the mu, raising low spots and thickening thin sections—the people suffer no hardship and the government spends nothing.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he wrote: "The riverside polder bases in Gaoyao and other counties are all earthen works; after the eleventh month each year magistrates lead villagers in labor by the mu, raising low spots and thickening thin sections—the people suffer no hardship and the government spends nothing

sentences.zh: 江漲不免衝決。

translations.literal: When the river rises, breaches cannot be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: When the river rises, breaches cannot be avoided.

sentences.zh: 但水性不猛，非必石工、椿埽方能抵禦。

translations.literal: But the water's force is not fierce, and stone works and pile-and-fascine defenses are not necessarily required to hold it back.
translations.idiomatic: But the current is not fierce, and stone works and pile-and-fascine defenses are not always needed to hold it back.

sentences.zh: 請仍循舊法，令有司於農隙督民修補。

translations.literal: I ask that the old method be kept, with the magistrates supervising the people in repairs during the slack season of farming.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that we keep the old method and have magistrates supervise repairs during the farming slack season.

sentences.zh: 倘江水盛漲，遣吏巡行防衝決，無煩改築費帑。

translations.literal: If the river should swell greatly, send clerks on patrol to guard against breaches, without the trouble of rebuilding at treasury expense.
translations.idiomatic: If the river should swell greatly, send clerks on patrol to guard against breaches, without the cost of rebuilding from the treasury.

sentences.zh: 」上為寢文乾議。

translations.literal: " The emperor set aside Yang Wenqian's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor set aside Yang Wenqian's proposal.

sentences.zh: 尋與毓珣合疏請遣廣南韶道、肇高廉羅道督修諸縣圍基，報聞。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he and Yu Xun jointly memorialized asking that the Guangnan-Shaozhou Circuit intendant and the Zhao-Gao-Lian-Luo Circuit intendant be sent to supervise repair of the polder bases in the various counties; the request was noted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he and Yu Xun jointly asked that the Guangnan-Shaozhou and Zhao-Gao-Lian-Luo circuit intendants be sent to supervise repair of the county polder bases; the request was noted.

sentences.zh: 蒼梧芋莢山礦民群聚竊發，阿克敦令捕得其渠，上諭嘉之。

translations.literal: At Cangwu's Yujia Mountain miners gathered in a mob and secretly opened a mine; Akedun ordered arrests and seized the ringleaders, and the emperor commended him.
translations.idiomatic: At Cangwu's Yujia Mountain miners gathered in a mob and secretly opened a mine; Akedun had the ringleaders arrested, and the emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 調吏部，署廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and acted as Governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel and served as acting Governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 劾肇高廉羅道王士俊侵稅羨，上以士俊尚可用，命訓飭遷改。

translations.literal: He impeached the Zhao-Gao-Lian-Luo Circuit intendant Wang Shijun for embezzling surplus tax silver; the emperor thought Shijun still usable and ordered him admonished and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Zhao-Gao-Lian-Luo Circuit intendant Wang Shijun for embezzling surplus tax silver; the emperor thought Shijun still usable and ordered him admonished and transferred.

sentences.zh: 改署廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: He was reassigned to act as Governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was reassigned to serve as acting Governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 文乾劾阿克敦聞盜不嚴緝，新會縣得盜，授意改讞，以竊賊詳結；

translations.literal: Wenqian impeached Akedun for hearing of bandits and not pursuing them strictly; when Xinhui County caught a bandit, he directed that the case be altered and closed as petty theft;
translations.idiomatic: Wenqian impeached Akedun for hearing of bandits and not pursuing them strictly; when Xinhui County caught a bandit, he directed that the case be altered and closed as petty theft;

sentences.zh: 侵粵海關耗銀，令家人索暹羅米船規禮。

translations.literal: he embezzled surplus silver from the Guangdong Customs, and had his household servants demand customary fees from Siamese rice boats.
translations.idiomatic: he embezzled surplus silver from the Guangdong Customs and had his household servants demand customary fees from Siamese rice boats.

sentences.zh: 毓珣亦劾侵太平關耗銀。

translations.literal: Yu Xun also impeached him for embezzling surplus silver at Taiping Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xun also impeached him for embezzling surplus silver at Taiping Pass.

sentences.zh: 六年，命奪阿克敦官，下毓珣、文乾會鞫，文乾卒，上遣通政使留保、郎中喀爾吉善會毓珣及署廣東巡撫傅泰嚴鞫，以諱盜、侵耗輕罪，不議坐；

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was stripped of office; Yu Xun and Wenqian were ordered to conduct a joint trial. Wenqian died, and the emperor sent Communications Commissioner Liubao and Director K'erjishan to join Yu Xun and the acting Governor of Guangdong Fu Tai in a strict trial; for concealing banditry and embezzling surplus silver they treated these as minor offenses and recommended no punishment;
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he was stripped of office and Yu Xun and Wenqian were ordered to try him jointly. Wenqian died, and the emperor sent Communications Commissioner Liubao and Director K'erjishan to join Yu Xun and acting Guangdong Governor Fu Tai in a strict trial; for concealing banditry and embezzling surplus silver they treated the charges as minor and recommended no punishment;

sentences.zh: 令家人索暹羅米船，擬絞。

translations.literal: for having household servants extort Siamese rice boats, they recommended strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: for having household servants extort Siamese rice boats, they recommended strangulation.

sentences.zh: 士俊复揭告阿克敦庇布政使官達婪贓，加擬斬監候。

translations.literal: Shijun again denounced Akedun for shielding the Provincial Treasurer Guan Da in greedy corruption, and the sentence was increased to deferred execution.
translations.idiomatic: Shijun again denounced Akedun for shielding Provincial Treasurer Guan Da in greedy corruption, and the sentence was increased to deferred execution.

sentences.zh: 七年，山東巡撫費金吾以疏濬江南徐州、沛縣及濟寧、嘉祥諸縣水道，請派員督修。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Governor of Shandong Fei Jinwu, for dredging the waterways of Xuzhou and Pei County in Jiangnan and of Jining, Jiaxiang, and other counties, asked that officials be dispatched to supervise the repairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Shandong Governor Fei Jinwu, for dredging waterways in Jiangnan's Xuzhou and Pei counties and in Jining, Jiaxiang, and other counties, asked that officials be dispatched to supervise the work.

sentences.zh: 上命釋阿克敦往江南河工效力自贖。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Akedun released to go to Jiangnan river works and redeem himself by service.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Akedun released to serve on Jiangnan river works and redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 九年，上命撫遠大將軍馬爾賽率師討準噶爾，授阿克敦內閣額外學士，協辦軍務。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the emperor ordered the Pacification Commissioner of the Far Marches Marshal Sai to lead an army against the Dzungars and made Akedun an extra academician of the Grand Secretariat to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 the emperor ordered Pacification Commissioner of the Far Marches Marshal Sai to lead an army against the Dzungars and made Akedun an extra Grand Secretariat academician to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一年，命駐紮克拜達里克督餉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was ordered to be stationed at Kebadalik to supervise supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he was ordered to be stationed at Kebadalik to supervise supplies.

sentences.zh: 十二年，召還。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 he was recalled.

sentences.zh: 命偕侍郎傅鼐、副都統羅密使準噶爾，宣諭噶爾丹策零，議罷兵息民。

translations.literal: He was ordered to go with Vice Minister Fu Nai and Vice Commander-in-Chief Luomi as envoys to the Dzungars to proclaim and instruct Galdan Tseren and discuss halting the war and giving the people rest.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to go with Vice Minister Fu Nai and Vice Commander-in-Chief Luomi as envoys to the Dzungars to proclaim the court's will to Galdan Tseren and discuss halting the war and giving the people rest.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀與準噶爾以阿爾泰山梁分界，噶爾丹策零欲以杭愛為界，收阿爾泰山為游牧地。

translations.literal: Khalkha and the Dzungars took the Altai ridge as their boundary; Galdan Tseren wished to make the Khangai the border and take the Altai as pastureland.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha and the Dzungars took the Altai ridge as their boundary; Galdan Tseren wished to make the Khangai the border and take the Altai as pastureland.

sentences.zh: 阿克敦與議三日不決，噶爾丹策零遣使吹那木喀從阿克敦等詣京師，請以哲爾格西喇呼魯烏蘇為喀爾喀游牧地界。

translations.literal: Akedun negotiated for three days without resolution; Galdan Tseren sent the envoy Chuinamuka to accompany Akedun and the others to the capital, asking that Jergesirahulusu be made the Khalkha pasture boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Akedun negotiated for three days without resolution; Galdan Tseren sent the envoy Chuinamuka to accompany Akedun and the others to the capital, asking that Jergesirahulusu be made the Khalkha pasture boundary.

sentences.zh: 十三年，阿克敦等至京師。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Akedun and the others reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 Akedun and the others reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 上以阿克敦等奏及地圖密寄北路副將軍策棱，令熟籌定議。

translations.literal: The emperor secretly sent Akedun's memorial and the maps to the Northern Route Vice General Tsewang, ordering him to consider the matter thoroughly and fix the agreement.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor secretly sent Akedun's memorial and the maps to Northern Route Vice General Tsewang, ordering him to consider the matter thoroughly and fix the agreement.

sentences.zh: 策棱言準噶爾游牧不得令過阿爾泰山。

translations.literal: Tsewang said the Dzungar nomads must not be allowed to cross the Altai.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang said the Dzungar nomads must not be allowed to cross the Altai.

sentences.zh: 議中輟。

translations.literal: The negotiations were suspended midway.
translations.idiomatic: The negotiations were suspended midway.

sentences.zh: 命阿克敦署鑲藍旗滿洲副都統、工部侍郎。

translations.literal: Akedun was ordered to act as Manchu Vice Commander-in-Chief of the Bordered Blue Banner and Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Akedun was ordered to serve as acting Manchu Vice Commander-in-Chief of the Bordered Blue Banner and Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，命守護泰陵。

translations.literal: When the Qianlong Emperor acceded, he was ordered to guard the Tailing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: When Qianlong acceded, he was ordered to guard the Tailing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年，復命阿克敦使準噶爾，以侍衛旺扎爾、台吉額默根為副，齎敕諭噶爾丹策零議界。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qianlong Akedun was again ordered as envoy to the Dzungars, with Bodyguard Wangzhar and Taiji Emegen as deputies, bearing an imperial edict to instruct Galdan Tseren on the border negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 3 Akedun was again sent as envoy to the Dzungars, with Bodyguard Wangzhar and Taiji Emegen as deputies, bearing an imperial edict to instruct Galdan Tseren on the border negotiations.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹策零使哈柳從阿克敦等詣京師，請準噶爾游牧不越阿爾泰山，而乞移布延圖、托爾和二卡倫入內地。

translations.literal: Galdan Tseren sent Halu to accompany Akedun and the others to the capital, asking that Dzungar nomads not cross the Altai and begging that the two border posts of Buyantu and Tuo'erhe be moved inland.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Tseren sent Halu to accompany Akedun and the others to the capital, asking that Dzungar nomads not cross the Altai and begging that the two border posts of Buyantu and Tuo'erhe be moved inland.

sentences.zh: 上謂游牧不越阿爾泰山，已可定議，而移二卡倫不可許。

translations.literal: The emperor said that keeping nomads from crossing the Altai could already be settled, but moving the two border posts could not be granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said that keeping nomads from crossing the Altai could already be settled, but moving the two border posts could not be granted.

sentences.zh: 命哈柳齎敕還。

translations.literal: Halu was ordered to return bearing the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Halu was ordered to return bearing the edict.

sentences.zh: 授阿克敦工部侍郎。

translations.literal: Akedun was appointed Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Akedun was appointed Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 五年，調刑部，復調吏部。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments, then transferred again to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 he was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments, then again to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 八年，授鑲藍旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was made Manchu Commander-in-Chief of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he was made Manchu Commander-in-Chief of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 十年，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he also served as Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he also served as Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he was appointed Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to serve as assisting Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he was ordered to serve as assisting Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 尋解以授傅恆。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was relieved and the post given to Fu Heng.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was relieved and the post given to Fu Heng.

sentences.zh: 四月，翰林院進孝賢皇后冊文，清文譯「皇妣」為「先太后」，上以為大誤，召阿克敦詢之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the Hanlin Academy presented the empress's investiture text; the Manchu translation rendered "imperial mother" as "former empress dowager," which the emperor regarded as a grave error, and he summoned Akedun to inquire.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Hanlin Academy presented the investiture text for Empress Xiaoxian; the Manchu translation rendered "imperial mother" as "former empress dowager," which the emperor regarded as a grave error, and he summoned Akedun to inquire.

sentences.zh: 阿克敦未候旨已退，上怒，謂阿​​克敦以解協辦大學士故怨望，奪官，下刑部，當大不敬律，擬斬監候。

translations.literal: Akedun withdrew before awaiting the imperial decision; the emperor was angry, saying Akedun harbored resentment because he had been relieved as assisting Grand Secretary, stripped him of office, sent him to the Ministry of Punishments, applied the statute on grave disrespect, and recommended deferred execution.
translations.idiomatic: Akedun withdrew before awaiting the imperial decision; the emperor was angry, saying Akedun harbored resentment because he had been relieved as assisting Grand Secretary, stripped him of office, sent him to the Ministry of Punishments, applied the statute on grave disrespect, and recommended deferred execution.

sentences.zh: 六月，命在內閣學士上行走，署工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he was ordered to serve on the Grand Secretariat as an academician above the rank and to act as Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was ordered to serve on the Grand Secretariat as an academician above the rank and to act as Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 七月，擢署刑部尚書，授鑲白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was promoted to act as Minister of Punishments and made Commander-in-Chief of the Hanjun Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was promoted to act as Minister of Punishments and made Commander-in-Chief of the Hanjun Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 十月，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he also served as Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he also served as Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十二月，復命協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he was again ordered to serve as assisting Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he was again ordered to serve as assisting Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 十四年，金川平，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, when the Jinchuan campaign was pacified, he was given the rank of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14, when the Jinchuan campaign was pacified, he was given the rank of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 連歲上幸木蘭、幸河南、幸盛京，皆命留京辦事，迭署左都御史、步軍統領。

translations.literal: In successive years when the emperor went to Mulan, to Henan, and to Shengjing, Akedun was each time ordered to remain in the capital to manage affairs, acting in turn as Censor-in-Chief of the Left and as Metropolitan Banner Commander.
