sentences.zh: 霸州北當築堤護城，保定縣西新莊至城東路甿村堤根逼溜，應加寬厚，其路甿村東至艾頭村接營田圍埝約五十餘裡，擬築月堤作重障。

translations.literal: North of Bazhou dikes should be built to protect the city; from Xinzhuang west of Baoding county to Lucun on the road east of the city the dike roots press the current and should be widened and thickened; from Lucun east to Aitou village where it meets the camp-field embankment, about fifty-odd li, we propose building crescent dikes as a second barrier.
translations.idiomatic: North of Bazhou dikes should be built to protect the city; from Xinzhuang west of Baoding county to Lucun on the road east of the city the dike roots press the current and should be widened and thickened; from Lucun east to Aitou village where it meets the camp-field embankment, about fifty-odd li, we propose building crescent dikes as a second barrier.

sentences.zh: 」嘉淦方銳意引永定河歸故道，河溢，傍河諸州縣被水。

translations.literal: ' Jiagan was then intent on diverting the Yongding River back to its old course; the river overflowed and the counties along its banks were inundated.
translations.idiomatic: ' Jiagan was then intent on diverting the Yongding River back to its old course; the river overflowed and the counties along its banks were inundated.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，諭曰：「朕聞永定河經理未善，固安、良鄉、涿州、雄縣、霸州諸州縣田畝往往被淹，孫嘉淦不能辭其責也。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year an edict said: 'We hear that management of the Yongding River has not been well done; fields in the prefectures and counties of Gu'an, Liangxiang, Zhuozhou, Xiongzhou, Bazhou, and others are often flooded—Sun Jiagan cannot escape responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year an edict said: 'We hear that management of the Yongding River has not been well done; fields in the prefectures and counties of Gu'an, Liangxiang, Zhuozhou, Xiongzhou, Bazhou, and others are often flooded—Sun Jiagan cannot escape responsibility.

sentences.zh: 」於是命大學士鄂爾泰蒞勘，請暫塞金門閘上游放水口，嘉淦奏：「旋開旋築，實與放水本意相左，將來泥沙壅入玉帶，恐為患更大。

translations.literal: ' Thereupon Grand Secretary Ortai was ordered to inspect on site and requested temporarily blocking the upstream outlet at Jinmen Sluice. Jiagan memorialized: 'Opening and closing in turn truly runs counter to the intent of releasing water; in future silt may choke Yudai, and the harm may be greater.
translations.idiomatic: ' Thereupon Grand Secretary Ortai was ordered to inspect on site and requested temporarily blocking the upstream outlet at Jinmen Sluice. Jiagan memorialized: 'Opening and closing in turn truly runs counter to the intent of releasing water; in future silt may choke Yudai, and the harm may be greater.

sentences.zh: 」諭曰：「此奏固是，然鄂爾泰慎重，欲籌萬全，卿不必固執己見。

translations.literal: ' An edict said: 'This memorial is certainly right, yet Ortai is cautious and wishes to plan for complete security—you need not cling stubbornly to your own view.
translations.idiomatic: ' An edict said: 'This memorial is certainly right, yet Ortai is cautious and wishes to plan for complete security—you need not cling stubbornly to your own view.

sentences.zh: 卿此事自任甚力，而料理未善，朕不能為卿諱。

translations.literal: You took this matter upon yourself with great energy, yet the handling was not well done—we cannot cover this up for you.
translations.idiomatic: You took this matter upon yourself with great energy, yet the handling was not well done—we cannot cover this up for you.

sentences.zh: 然朕終以卿為是者，不似顧琮為游移巧詐之計耳。

translations.literal: Yet in the end We hold you in the right—not like Gu Cong's shifting, crafty schemes.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the end We hold you in the right—not like Gu Cong's shifting, crafty schemes.

sentences.zh: 」其後上巡天津，閱中亭河工，賦詩紀事，猶病嘉淦之失計也。

translations.literal: ' Later the Emperor toured Tianjin, inspected the Zhongting river works, and composed a poem on the occasion—still finding fault with Jiagan's miscalculation.
translations.idiomatic: ' Later the Emperor toured Tianjin, inspected the Zhongting river works, and composed a poem on the occasion—still finding fault with Jiagan's miscalculation.

sentences.zh: 是年八月，調湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year he was transferred to governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year he was transferred to governor-general of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 七年五月，疏言：「內地武弁不得乾預民事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year he memorialized: 'In the interior, military officers may not interfere in civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventh year he memorialized: 'In the interior, military officers may not interfere in civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 苗疆獨不然，文員不敢輕入峒寨，但令差役催科，持票滋擾而已。

translations.literal: The Miao frontier alone is not so: civil officials dare not lightly enter stockaded villages and only send runners to collect taxes, who with their warrants merely add to the harassment.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao frontier alone is not so: civil officials dare not lightly enter stockaded villages and only send runners to collect taxes, who with their warrants merely add to the harassment.

sentences.zh: 爭訟劫殺之案，皆委之於武弁，威權所及，攤派隨之。

translations.literal: Cases of dispute, robbery, and murder are all entrusted to military officers; wherever their authority reaches, levies follow.
translations.idiomatic: Cases of dispute, robbery, and murder are all entrusted to military officers; wherever their authority reaches, levies follow.

sentences.zh: 於是因公科斂，文武各行其令；

translations.literal: Thus on public pretext they levy exactions, civil and military each issuing their own orders;
translations.idiomatic: Thus on public pretext they levy exactions, civil and military each issuing their own orders;

sentences.zh: 因事需索，兵役競逞其能；

translations.literal: on any occasion they demand goods, soldiers and clerks vie to show their power;
translations.idiomatic: on any occasion they demand goods, soldiers and clerks vie to show their power;

sentences.zh: 甚至沒其家貲，辱及婦女。

translations.literal: even seizing families' property and dishonoring their women.
translations.idiomatic: even seizing families' property and dishonoring their women.

sentences.zh: 苗民不勝其忿，與之並命，而嫌釁遂成。

translations.literal: The Miao people cannot bear their rage and stake their lives against them, and grievances thus arise.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao people cannot bear their rage and stake their lives against them, and grievances thus arise.

sentences.zh: 為大吏者，或剿或撫，意見各殊。

translations.literal: Among high officials, some favor suppression and some pacification; opinions differ.
translations.idiomatic: Among high officials, some favor suppression and some pacification; opinions differ.

sentences.zh: 行文查勘，動經數月。

translations.literal: Memorials for investigation often take months.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials for investigation often take months.

sentences.zh: 苗得聞風豫備，四處句連，飲血酒，傳木刻，亂起甚易，戡定實難。

translations.literal: The Miao hear wind of it and prepare in advance, linking up everywhere, drinking blood wine and passing wooden tokens—rebellion rises easily, pacification is truly hard.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao hear wind of it and prepare in advance, linking up everywhere, drinking blood wine and passing wooden tokens—rebellion rises easily, pacification is truly hard.

sentences.zh: 幸就削平，而後之​​人仍蹈前轍，搜捕株連，滋擾益甚。

translations.literal: Fortunately they are soon suppressed, yet later men still tread the old path—searching, arresting, and implicating—so harassment grows worse.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately they are soon suppressed, yet later men still tread the old path—searching, arresting, and implicating—so harassment grows worse.

sentences.zh: 苗、瑤無所告訴，乘隙復動，惟力是視。

translations.literal: Miao and Yao have nowhere to appeal; seizing an opening they rise again, seeing only force.
translations.idiomatic: Miao and Yao have nowhere to appeal; seizing an opening they rise again, seeing only force.

sentences.zh: 歷來治苗之官，既無愛養之道，又乏約束之方。

translations.literal: Officials who have governed the Miao through the ages have had neither ways to cherish and nurture them nor means to restrain abuse.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who have governed the Miao through the ages have had neither ways to cherish and nurture them nor means to restrain abuse.

sentences.zh: 無事恣其侵漁，有事止於剿殺。

translations.literal: In peace they let them prey at will; in crisis they stop at suppression and slaughter.
translations.idiomatic: In peace they let them prey at will; in crisis they stop at suppression and slaughter.

sentences.zh: 剿殺之後，仍事侵漁。

translations.literal: After suppression and slaughter, they still prey.
translations.idiomatic: After suppression and slaughter, they still prey.

sentences.zh: 侵漁既久，勢必又至剿殺。

translations.literal: When preying has gone on long, suppression and slaughter must come again.
translations.idiomatic: When preying has gone on long, suppression and slaughter must come again.

sentences.zh: 長此循環，伊於胡底。

translations.literal: Continue this cycle—where will it end?
translations.idiomatic: Continue this cycle—where will it end?

sentences.zh: 語曰：'善為政者，因其勢而利導之。

translations.literal: The saying runs: 'He who governs well guides people according to their tendencies and leads them to profit.
translations.idiomatic: The saying runs: 'He who governs well guides people according to their tendencies and leads them to profit.

sentences.zh: '苗人散居，各有頭人。

translations.literal: ' The Miao live scattered, each group with its headman.
translations.idiomatic: ' The Miao live scattered, each group with its headman.

sentences.zh: 凡作姦窩匪之處，兵役偵之而不得者，頭人能知之；

translations.literal: Wherever wrongdoing and bandit dens hide, what soldiers and clerks cannot detect, headmen can know;
translations.idiomatic: Wherever wrongdoing and bandit dens hide, what soldiers and clerks cannot detect, headmen can know;

sentences.zh: 鬥爭劫殺之事，官法繩之而不解者，頭人能調之。

translations.literal: in cases of brawling, robbery, and murder that official law cannot settle, headmen can mediate.
translations.idiomatic: in cases of brawling, robbery, and murder that official law cannot settle, headmen can mediate.

sentences.zh: 故治苗在治頭人，令各寨用頭人為寨長。

translations.literal: Thus to govern the Miao is to govern the headmen—let each stockade appoint its headman as stockade chief.
translations.idiomatic: Thus to govern the Miao is to govern the headmen—let each stockade appoint its headman as stockade chief.

sentences.zh: 一峒之中，取頭人所信服者為峒長，使各約束寨長而聽於縣令。

translations.literal: Within each ravine community, choose the headman the others trust as ravine chief, so each restrains his stockade chiefs and obeys the magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Within each ravine community, choose the headman the others trust as ravine chief, so each restrains his stockade chiefs and obeys the magistrate.

sentences.zh: 眾苗有事，寨長處之不能，以告峒長；

translations.literal: When the Miao have a matter the stockade chief cannot settle, he reports to the ravine chief;
translations.idiomatic: When the Miao have a matter the stockade chief cannot settle, he reports to the ravine chief;

sentences.zh: 又不能，以告縣令。

translations.literal: if he still cannot, he reports to the magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: if he still cannot, he reports to the magistrate.

sentences.zh: 如是，則於苗疆有提綱挈領之方，於有司自收令行禁止之效。

translations.literal: Thus in the Miao frontier there is a way to grasp the guiding rope, and officials themselves gain the effect of orders obeyed and prohibitions enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in the Miao frontier there is a way to grasp the guiding rope, and officials themselves gain the effect of orders obeyed and prohibitions enforced.

sentences.zh: 且峒長數見牧令，有爭訟可告官區處，而無仇殺之舉。

translations.literal: Moreover, ravine chiefs will often see the prefectural magistrate; disputes can be brought to officials for settlement, and there will be no vendetta killings.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, ravine chiefs will often see the prefectural magistrate; disputes can be brought to officials for settlement, and there will be no vendetta killings.

sentences.zh: 牧令數見峒長，有條教可面飭遵行，而無吏役熒蔽之患。

translations.literal: The magistrate will often see ravine chiefs; regulations can be enjoined face to face for compliance, without the harm of clerks and runners deceiving and concealing.
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate will often see ravine chiefs; regulations can be enjoined face to face for compliance, without the harm of clerks and runners deceiving and concealing.

sentences.zh: 擾累既杜，則心志易孚。

translations.literal: Once harassment is stopped, hearts are easily won.
translations.idiomatic: Once harassment is stopped, hearts are easily won.

sentences.zh: 所謂立法簡易，因其俗而利導者也。

translations.literal: This is what is meant by making laws simple and guiding people according to their customs to their benefit.
translations.idiomatic: This is what is meant by making laws simple and guiding people according to their customs to their benefit.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，命署福建巡撫，未赴，湖南糧道謝濟世劾善化知縣樊德貽、衡陽知縣李澎浮收漕米，巡撫許容庇德貽等，疏劾濟世，下嘉淦察讞。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year he was ordered to serve as acting Fujian governor but had not yet gone when the Hunan grain intendant Xie Jishi impeached the Shanhua magistrate Fan Deyi and the Hengyang magistrate Li Peng for over-collecting transport rice; the governor Xu Rong shielded Deyi and others and memorialized against Jishi. The case was sent to Jiagan for investigation and judgment.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year he was ordered to serve as acting Fujian governor but had not yet gone when the Hunan grain intendant Xie Jishi impeached the Shanhua magistrate Fan Deyi and the Hengyang magistrate Li Peng for over-collecting transport rice; the governor Xu Rong shielded Deyi and others and memorialized against Jishi. The case was sent to Jiagan for investigation and judgment.

sentences.zh: 長沙知府張琳按衡陽丁役，得浮收狀，申署糧道倉德，布政使張璨致書倉德，請易府牒。

translations.literal: The Changsha prefect Zhang Lin inspected Hengyang corvée levies, obtained evidence of over-collection, and reported to the acting grain intendant Cang De; the provincial treasurer Zhang Can wrote to Cang De asking to alter the prefectural dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: The Changsha prefect Zhang Lin inspected Hengyang corvée levies, obtained evidence of over-collection, and reported to the acting grain intendant Cang De; the provincial treasurer Zhang Can wrote to Cang De asking to alter the prefectural dispatch.

sentences.zh: 倉德持不可，以其實揭報嘉淦及漕運總督顧琮。

translations.literal: Cang De refused to agree and reported the facts to Jiagan and the Director-General of Grain Transport Gu Cong.
translations.idiomatic: Cang De refused to agree and reported the facts to Jiagan and the Director-General of Grain Transport Gu Cong.

sentences.zh: 嘉淦欲寢其事，而顧琮以上聞。

translations.literal: Jiagan wished to bury the matter, but Gu Cong reported it to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Jiagan wished to bury the matter, but Gu Cong reported it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 御史胡定复論劾倉德，又揭都察院，上遣侍郎阿里袞往按，直濟世。

translations.literal: The censor Hu Ding again impeached Cang De and also posted a notice at the Censorate; the Emperor sent Vice Minister Aligun to investigate and vindicated Jishi.
translations.idiomatic: The censor Hu Ding again impeached Cang De and also posted a notice at the Censorate; the Emperor sent Vice Minister Aligun to investigate and vindicated Jishi.

sentences.zh: 上責嘉淦徇庇，奪官，責修順義城工。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked Jiagan for favoritism, stripped his office, and assigned him to repair the Shunyi city works.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked Jiagan for favoritism, stripped his office, and assigned him to repair the Shunyi city works.

sentences.zh: 九年，授宗人府府丞。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十二年，以老乞休，許之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, citing age, he asked to retire and was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, citing age, he asked to retire and was permitted.

sentences.zh: 十四年，召來京，直上書房。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was summoned to the capital and entered the Upper Study directly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was summoned to the capital and entered the Upper Study directly.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，授兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year he was appointed Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year he was appointed Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 八月，擢工部尚書，署翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he was promoted to Minister of Works and served concurrently as Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was promoted to Minister of Works and served concurrently as Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十七年，進吏部尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he advanced to Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he advanced to Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 十八年十二月，卒，年七十有一，諡文定。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eighteenth year he died, aged seventy-one; his posthumous title was Wending.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the eighteenth year he died, aged seventy-one; his posthumous title was Wending.

sentences.zh: 嘉淦居官為八約，曰：「事君篤而不顯，與人共而不驕，勢避其所爭，功藏於無名，事止於能去，言刪其無用，以守獨避人，以清費廉取。

translations.literal: In office Jiagan set himself eight precepts, saying: 'Serve the ruler with devotion but without display; share with others without arrogance; avoid the contests of power; hide merit in obscurity; stop at what one can relinquish; prune speech of what is useless; keep integrity by shunning the crowd; take frugally through purity of expense.
translations.idiomatic: In office Jiagan set himself eight precepts, saying: 'Serve the ruler with devotion but without display; share with others without arrogance; avoid the contests of power; hide merit in obscurity; stop at what one can relinquish; prune speech of what is useless; keep integrity by shunning the crowd; take frugally through purity of expense.

sentences.zh: 」用以自戒。

translations.literal: ' He used these to admonish himself.
translations.idiomatic: ' He used these to admonish himself.

sentences.zh: 既以直諫有聲，乾隆初，疏匡主德，尤為時所慕。

translations.literal: Already famed for forthright remonstrance, in the early Qianlong reign his memorials to correct the ruler's virtue were especially admired by the age.
translations.idiomatic: Already famed for forthright remonstrance, in the early Qianlong reign his memorials to correct the ruler's virtue were especially admired by the age.

sentences.zh: 四年，京師市井傳嘉淦疏稿論劾大學士鄂爾泰、張廷玉等，高宗諭步軍統領、巡城御史嚴禁。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the markets of the capital circulated a draft memorial in Jiagan's name impeaching Grand Secretaries Ortai, Zhang Tingyu, and others; the Qianlong Emperor ordered the Metropolitan Banner commander and the city patrol censors to forbid it strictly.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the markets of the capital circulated a draft memorial in Jiagan's name impeaching Grand Secretaries Ortai, Zhang Tingyu, and others; the Qianlong Emperor ordered the Metropolitan Banner commander and the city patrol censors to forbid it strictly.

sentences.zh: 十六年，或又傳嘉淦疏稿斥言上失德有五不可解、十大過，雲貴總督碩色以聞。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year another draft in Jiagan's name circulated, denouncing the ruler's moral failings as five inexplicable points and ten great faults; the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Shuose reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year another draft in Jiagan's name circulated, denouncing the ruler's moral failings as five inexplicable points and ten great faults; the Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Shuose reported it.

sentences.zh: 命求所從來，遣使者督讞。

translations.literal: He ordered the source traced and sent envoys to supervise the investigation.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the source traced and sent envoys to supervise the investigation.

sentences.zh: 轉相連染，歷六省，更三歲，乃坐江西衛千總盧魯生偽為，罪至死。

translations.literal: The case spread by implication through six provinces; after three years it was fixed on Lu Lusheng, a company commander of the Jiangxi garrison, as the forger, and he was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: The case spread by implication through six provinces; after three years it was fixed on Lu Lusheng, a company commander of the Jiangxi garrison, as the forger, and he was sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 高宗知無與嘉淦事，眷不替，嘉淦益自抑。

translations.literal: The Qianlong Emperor knew Jiagan had no part in it; his favor did not wane, and Jiagan restrained himself all the more.
translations.idiomatic: The Qianlong Emperor knew Jiagan had no part in it; his favor did not wane, and Jiagan restrained himself all the more.

sentences.zh: 嘗著書述春秋義，自以為不足，毀之。

translations.literal: He once wrote a book expounding the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals, found it inadequate himself, and destroyed it.
translations.idiomatic: He once wrote a book expounding the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals, found it inadequate himself, and destroyed it.

sentences.zh: 子孝愉，以廕生授刑部主事，官至直隸按察使。

translations.literal: His son Xiaoyu, by hereditary privilege appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, rose to provincial surveillance commissioner of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xiaoyu, by hereditary privilege appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments, rose to provincial surveillance commissioner of Zhili.

sentences.zh: 梁詩正，字養仲，浙江錢塘人。

translations.literal: Liang Shizheng, style name Yangzhong, was a native of Qiantang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Shizheng, style name Yangzhong, was a native of Qiantang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 雍正八年進士及第，授編修。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of the Yongzheng reign he placed first in the metropolitan examination and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of the Yongzheng reign he placed first in the metropolitan examination and was appointed compiler.

sentences.zh: 累遷侍講學士。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Reader-in-Waiting of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted repeatedly to Reader-in-Waiting of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十三年，以母憂歸。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he returned home for his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he returned home for his mother's mourning.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，召南書房行走。

translations.literal: When the Qianlong Emperor ascended the throne, he was summoned as an attendant of the Southern Study.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qianlong Emperor ascended the throne, he was summoned as an attendant of the Southern Study.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三年，補侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In the third year of the Qianlong reign he was appointed Reader-in-Waiting of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Qianlong reign he was made Reader-in-Waiting of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 累遷戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through repeated promotions to Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 詩正疏言：「八旗除各省駐防與近京五百里俱聽屯種，餘並隨旗駐京。

translations.literal: Shizheng memorialized: 'Among the Eight Banners, aside from garrisons in the provinces and within five hundred li of the capital where farming is permitted, the rest all follow their banners to reside in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shizheng memorialized: 'Among the Eight Banners, aside from provincial garrisons and lands within five hundred li of the capital where farming is permitted, the rest all follow their banners to reside in the capital.

sentences.zh: 皇上為旗人資生計者，委曲備至，而旗人仍不免窮乏。

translations.literal: The Emperor's provisions for the bannermen's livelihood have been thorough in every detail, yet the bannermen still cannot escape poverty.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor has made every conceivable provision for the bannermen's livelihood, yet they still cannot escape poverty.

sentences.zh: 蓋生齒日繁，若不使自為養，而常欲官養之，勢有不能。

translations.literal: This is because mouths multiply daily; if they are not made to support themselves but the state always wishes to support them, the situation makes this impossible.
translations.idiomatic: This is because mouths multiply daily; if people are not made to support themselves but the state always tries to support them, it cannot be done.

sentences.zh: 臣謂非屯田不可。

translations.literal: Your servant holds that nothing but military colonies will suffice.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant holds that nothing but military colonies will suffice.

sentences.zh: 今內地無閒田，興、盛二京膏腴未盡闢。

translations.literal: Now in the interior there is no idle land; the fertile soil of the two capitals at Xingjing and Shengjing is not yet fully opened.
translations.idiomatic: Now in the interior there is no idle land; the fertile soil of the two capitals at Xingjing and Shengjing is not yet fully opened.

sentences.zh: 世宗時，欲令黑龍江、寧古塔等處分駐旗人耕種，已有成議，未及舉行。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng reign it was wished to station bannermen to farm in Heilongjiang, Ningguta, and other places; agreement was already reached but not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yongzheng Emperor it was proposed to station bannermen to farm in Heilongjiang, Ningguta, and other places; agreement was already reached but the plan was never carried out.

sentences.zh: 今不早為之所，數百年後，旗戶十倍於今。

translations.literal: If measures are not taken early, in several hundred years banner households will be ten times what they are today.
translations.idiomatic: If we do not act early, in several hundred years banner households will be ten times what they are today.

sentences.zh: 以有數之錢糧，贍無窮之生齒，使取給於額餉之內，則兵弁之關支，不足供閒散之坐食；

translations.literal: With a fixed amount of money and grain to support endless mouths, if they are supplied within the quota pay, then the stipends of officers and soldiers will not suffice for the idle who merely eat;
translations.idiomatic: With a fixed amount of money and grain to support endless mouths, if all are supplied within the quota pay, officers' and soldiers' stipends will not suffice for the idle who merely eat;

sentences.zh: 使取給於額餉之外，則民賦不能加，國用不能缺。

translations.literal: if they are supplied outside the quota pay, the people's taxes cannot be raised and state expenditure cannot be cut.
translations.idiomatic: if they are supplied outside the quota pay, the people's taxes cannot be raised and state expenditure cannot be reduced.

sentences.zh: 戶口日繁，待食者眾，無餘財給之，京師亦無餘地處之。

translations.literal: Households grow daily; those awaiting support are many; there is no surplus wealth to give them, and the capital also has no surplus land to place them.
translations.idiomatic: Households grow daily; those awaiting support are many; there is no surplus wealth to give them, and the capital has no surplus land to place them.

sentences.zh: 惟有酌派戶口，散列邊屯，使世享耕牧之利，以時講武，亦以實邊。

translations.literal: The only course is to apportion households judiciously and scatter them in frontier colonies so they may enjoy farming and herding for generations, drill arms in season, and also strengthen the border.
translations.idiomatic: The only course is to apportion households judiciously and scatter them in frontier colonies so they may enjoy farming and herding for generations, drill arms in season, and strengthen the border.

sentences.zh: 諸行省綠營馬步兵餉，較康熙年間漸增至五六百萬。

translations.literal: The pay of Green Standard cavalry and infantry in the provinces has gradually risen to five or six million compared with the Kangxi reign.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard cavalry and infantry pay in the provinces has gradually risen to five or six million taels compared with the Kangxi reign.

sentences.zh: 在各標營、鎮協每處浮數十百名，不覺其多；

translations.literal: At each brigade, camp, garrison, and command a few dozen or hundred extra men seem not many;
translations.idiomatic: At each brigade, camp, garrison, and command a few dozen or hundred extra men seem insignificant;

sentences.zh: 在朝廷合計兵餉，則冗額歲不下數十百萬。

translations.literal: but when the court totals military pay, supernumerary quotas amount to no less than several million yearly.
translations.idiomatic: but when the court totals military pay, supernumerary quotas amount to several million taels a year.

sentences.zh: 各省錢糧，大半留充兵餉，其不敷者，鄰省協撥，而解部之項日少。

translations.literal: In each province most land tax and grain tribute is retained for military pay; where it falls short, neighboring provinces assist, and sums remitted to the ministry grow daily fewer.
translations.idiomatic: In each province most land tax and grain tribute is retained for military pay; where it falls short, neighboring provinces assist, and sums remitted to the ministry grow ever fewer.

sentences.zh: 向來各營多空糧，自雍正元年清查，此弊盡除。

translations.literal: Formerly every camp had much phantom grain on the rolls; since the audit of the first year of Yongzheng this abuse has been wholly removed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly every camp had much phantom grain on the rolls; since the audit of the first year of Yongzheng this abuse has been wholly removed.

sentences.zh: 是近年兵額但依舊制，已比前有虛實之別。

translations.literal: Thus in recent years, though troop quotas follow the old establishment, there is already a difference between phantom and real compared with before.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in recent years, though troop quotas follow the old establishment, the rolls are already more honest than before.

sentences.zh: 況直省要害之地，多滿洲駐防，與各標營、鎮協聲勢聯絡，其增設兵額可以裁汰者，宜令酌定數目，遇開除空缺，即停止募補。

translations.literal: Moreover, in key places in the provinces Manchu garrisons are stationed, linked in strength with the various brigades, camps, garrisons, and commands; where added troop quotas may be cut, they should be ordered to fix the numbers judiciously, and when vacancies open through dismissal, recruitment should cease at once.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in key places in the provinces Manchu garrisons are stationed, linked in strength with the various brigades, camps, garrisons, and commands; where added troop quotas may be cut, officials should fix the numbers judiciously, and when vacancies open through dismissal, recruitment should cease at once.

sentences.zh: 庶將來營製漸有節省，而現在兵丁無苦裁汰。

translations.literal: Thus in future the military establishment may gradually be economized, while present soldiers suffer no hardship from sudden cuts.
translations.idiomatic: Thus in future the military establishment may gradually be economized, while present soldiers suffer no hardship from sudden cuts.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢戶部尚書，詩正疏言：「每歲天下租賦，以供官兵俸餉各項經費，惟餘二百餘萬，實不足備水旱兵戈之用。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Minister of Revenue. Shizheng memorialized: 'Each year the empire's land tax and tribute, after supplying officers' and soldiers' salaries and all other expenses, leaves only a little more than two million—truly insufficient to meet flood, drought, or war.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was promoted to Minister of Revenue. Shizheng memorialized: 'Each year the empire's land tax and tribute, after supplying officers' and soldiers' salaries and all other expenses, leaves only a little more than two million taels—far too little for flood, drought, or war.

sentences.zh: 今雖府庫充盈，皇上宜以節儉為要，勿興土木之工、黷武之師，庶以持盈保泰。

translations.literal: Though the treasuries are now full, Your Majesty should take frugality as essential, not launch works of earth and wood or warlike campaigns, so as to hold fullness and preserve peace.
translations.idiomatic: Though the treasuries are now full, Your Majesty should take frugality as essential, not launch great construction or warlike campaigns, so as to hold fullness and preserve peace.

sentences.zh: 」十三年，調兵部尚書。

translations.literal: ' In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: ' In the thirteenth year he was transferred to Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 十四年，加太子少師，兼刑部尚書、翰林院掌院學士、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and concurrently Minister of Punishments, Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and concurrently Minister of Punishments, Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy, and Associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 十五年，調吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was transferred to Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 御史歐堪善疏劾詩正徇庇行私，上召諸大臣及堪善廷詰。

translations.literal: The censor Ou Kanshan memorialized impeaching Shizheng for favoritism and private dealings; the Emperor summoned the ministers and Kanshan for court interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: The censor Ou Kanshan memorialized impeaching Shizheng for favoritism and private dealings; the Emperor summoned the ministers and Kanshan for court interrogation.

sentences.zh: 所劾皆無據，惟翰林院輪班引見，偶有越次。

translations.literal: The charges were all groundless; only in the Hanlin Academy's rotating audience presentations there were occasional breaches of order.
translations.idiomatic: The charges were all groundless; only in the Hanlin Academy's rotating audience presentations there were occasional breaches of order.

sentences.zh: 上諭曰：「梁詩正職在內廷，不過文學供奉，朕何如主，而謂諸臣能恣行其胸臆乎？

translations.literal: An edict said: 'Liang Shizheng's post is in the inner court—nothing but literary service. What sort of ruler do We seem, that ministers could act on their private whims?
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: 'Liang Shizheng's post is in the inner court—nothing but literary service. What sort of ruler do We seem, that ministers could act on their private whims?

sentences.zh: 至小小瞻徇私情，則不獨詩正，諸大臣恐俱未能盡絕。

translations.literal: As for small favoritism in looking after private ties, not Shizheng alone—perhaps all the ministers cannot wholly eliminate it.
translations.idiomatic: As for small favoritism in looking after private ties, not Shizheng alone—perhaps no minister can wholly eliminate it.

sentences.zh: 如張廷玉掌院三十年，引見越次，不知凡幾，何以未聞論劾？

translations.literal: Zhang Tingyu headed the Academy for thirty years; how many times did audiences breach order—why was no impeachment heard?
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingyu headed the Academy for thirty years; how many times did audiences breach order—why was no impeachment heard?

sentences.zh: 詩正有此一二可議，即被論劾，得以知所儆省，未始非福。

translations.literal: Shizheng has these one or two points open to criticism and is impeached—he may know where to warn and restrain himself; this is not necessarily misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Shizheng has these one or two points open to criticism and is impeached—he may know where to warn and restrain himself; this is not necessarily a misfortune.

sentences.zh: 堪善之言，當以為感，不當以為怨也。

translations.literal: Kanshan's words should be taken as a stimulus, not as a grievance.
translations.idiomatic: Kanshan's words should be taken as a stimulus, not as a grievance.

sentences.zh: 」會御史儲麟趾劾四川學政硃荃匿喪，上詢詩正，詩正對失指，下吏議，當奪職，命留任。

translations.literal: ' At the same time the censor Chu Linzhi impeached the Sichuan education commissioner Zhu Quan for concealing mourning; the Emperor questioned Shizheng, whose answer missed the point. The case went to the judicial offices, which ruled he should be stripped of office, but he was ordered to remain in post.
translations.idiomatic: ' At the same time the censor Chu Linzhi impeached the Sichuan education commissioner Zhu Quan for concealing mourning; the Emperor questioned Shizheng, whose answer missed the point. The case went to the judicial offices, which ruled he should be stripped of office, but he was ordered to remain in post.

sentences.zh: 十六年，從上南巡，詩正父文濂年八十，予封典。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he accompanied the Emperor on the southern tour; Shizheng's father Wenlian was eighty, and ennoblement was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he accompanied the Emperor on the southern tour; Shizheng's father Wenlian was eighty, and ennoblement was granted.

sentences.zh: 十七年，疏乞終養。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he memorialized asking to nurse his father to the end.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he memorialized asking to nurse his father to the end.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，丁父憂，召署工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, upon his father's death, he was summoned to serve as acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, upon his father's death, he was summoned to serve as acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，調署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to acting Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to acting Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，服闋，真除，仍命協辦大學士，兼翰林院掌院學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, when mourning ended, he received regular appointment and was again ordered Associate Grand Secretary and concurrent Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, when mourning ended, he received regular appointment and was again made Associate Grand Secretary and concurrent Chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，授東閣大學士，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion and made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，諡文莊。

translations.literal: Soon after he died; his posthumous title was Wenzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he died; his posthumous title was Wenzhuang.

sentences.zh: 子同書，舉人，賜進士，官至翰林院侍讀；

translations.literal: His son Tongshu, a provincial graduate, was granted metropolitan graduate status and rose to Reader of the Hanlin Academy;
translations.idiomatic: His son Tongshu, a provincial graduate, was granted metropolitan graduate status and rose to Reader of the Hanlin Academy;

sentences.zh: 敦書，官至兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Dunshu rose to Right Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Dunshu rose to Right Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 論曰：福敏以謹厚為高宗師。

translations.literal: The judgment says: Fu Min, with his careful steadfastness, was teacher to the Qianlong Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The judgment says: Fu Min, with his careful steadfastness, was teacher to the Qianlong Emperor.

sentences.zh: 世倌、貽直立朝有風節，雖坐譴，皆近私，大德不逾，卒不以相掩。

translations.literal: Shiguan and Yizhi had integrity at court; though they suffered reprimand, all were for private matters, their great virtue was not exceeded, and in the end their faults did not obscure them.
translations.idiomatic: Shiguan and Yizhi had integrity at court; though they suffered reprimand, all were for private matters, their great virtue was not exceeded, and in the end their faults did not obscure them.

sentences.zh: 阿克敦惇大而清介。

translations.literal: Akedun was sincere and magnanimous, pure and upright.
translations.idiomatic: Akedun was sincere and magnanimous, pure and upright.

sentences.zh: 嘉淦諤諤，陳善閉邪，一朝推名疏。

translations.literal: Jiagan was outspoken in remonstrance, presenting good and shutting out evil; in a single reign he was famed for his memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Jiagan was outspoken in remonstrance, presenting good and shutting out evil; in a single reign he was famed for his memorials.

sentences.zh: 詩正論八旗當行邊屯，綠營當停募補，掌國計雖歲有餘，惓惓惟懼不足，其慮遠矣。

translations.literal: Shizheng argued that the Eight Banners should practice frontier colonies and the Green Standards should cease recruitment to fill vacancies; though he managed state finances with yearly surpluses, he was earnest in fearing insufficiency—his foresight was far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: Shizheng argued that the Eight Banners should practice frontier colonies and the Green Standards should cease recruitment to fill vacancies; though he managed state finances with yearly surpluses, he was earnest in fearing insufficiency—his foresight was far-reaching.
